title: Resolving the interfacial mechanical landscape of monolayer NbSe2 grown by confined epitaxy
summary: Confined epitaxy has recently emerged as a novel methodology for controlled growth of high-quality monolayer two-dimensional (2D) materials. However, mechanistic understanding remains limited to analysing nucleus adsorption and diffusion barriers. Here, I discover that van der Waals (vdW) confinement not only affects the specific adsorption and diffusion of nuclei on confined substrates but also induces strong coupling to atomic forces at the interface. Using artificial intelligence (AI) assisted density functional theory (DFT) calculations, I study how vdW confinement couples to the atomic motion of monolayer NbSe2 grown between c-plane sapphire and hexagonal boron nitride (h-BN). The calculated force-electronic landscape yields large mechanical forces of +0.070 and -0.04 eV per Angstrom on Nb and Se, respectively, giving rise to a unit-cell interfacial interaction energy up to 2.4 eV, comparable to reported adsorption and diffusion energies on similar substrates. The results indicate that interfacial mechanics may explain the success of confined epitaxy. The findings suggest that tuning interfacial mechanics, and related vdW mechanochemistry, could be a promising route to high-throughput, high-quality materials synthesis.

AI.tldr: 受限外延是生长高质量单层2D材料的新方法，但其机理研究仅停留在成核吸附与扩散势垒分析。本文借助AI辅助DFT，发现vdW限域还诱导界面原子力的强耦合，可能解释受限外延的成功。
AI.motivation: 受限外延近来成为可控生长高质量单层二维材料的新方法，但机理理解仅局限于分析成核吸附与扩散势垒，忽略了限域对界面原子力等力学因素的潜在影响。
AI.method: 采用AI辅助的密度泛函理论（DFT）计算，研究在c面蓝宝石与六方氮化硼（h-BN）之间生长的单层NbSe2中vdW限域如何耦合其原子运动，并计算力-电子景观。
AI.result: 计算得到Nb和Se上的大机械力分别为+0.070和-0.04 eV/Å，单胞界面相互作用能高达2.4 eV，与类似基底上报道的吸附和扩散能相当。
AI.conclusion: 界面力学可能解释受限外延的成功；调控界面力学及相关vdW机械化学，有望成为高通量、高质量材料合成的有效途径。

title: Hierarchical Relaxation in Large-twist-angle Moire Drives Supermoire Formation
summary: Supermoire lattices in large-angle twisted bilayers have recently been shown to emerge from periodic arrangements of commensurate stacking motifs, yet the microscopic structural mechanism governing their formation has remained unresolved. Here, we uncover the microscopic origin of supermoire order as a hierarchical lattice relaxation process. Combining force-field simulations with experimental validation via super-resolution, layer-resolved multislice electron ptychography, our results identify interlayer Se-Se repulsion at the picometer scale as the driving force, giving rise to coupled short-range (about 1 nm) moire relaxation and coexisting long-range (about 10 nm) supermoire modulation. These findings demonstrate that even picometer-scale lattice relaxation remains critical in large-angle moire systems and must be explicitly considered in understanding their emergent electronic and quantum phenomena.

AI.tldr: 该文揭示了大角度扭转双层中"超莫尔"序的微观起源：它是一个层级式晶格弛豫过程，由皮米尺度的层间Se-Se排斥驱动，产生短程(~1 nm)莫尔弛豫与长程(~10 nm)超莫尔调制共存。
AI.motivation: 大角度扭转双层中已观察到由公度堆垛基元周期性排列形成的超莫尔晶格，但其形成的微观结构机制此前尚未解决。作者希望阐明这一超莫尔序的微观起源。
AI.method: 结合力场模拟与实验验证。实验采用超分辨、层分辨的多层电子叠层成像(ptychography)进行结构表征。
AI.result: 识别出皮米尺度的层间Se-Se排斥是驱动力，导致耦合的短程(~1 nm)莫尔弛豫与共存的长程(~10 nm)超莫尔调制。
AI.conclusion: 即使皮米尺度的晶格弛豫在大角度莫尔体系中依然关键，必须在理解其涌现的电子与量子现象时予以显式考虑。

title: Ceramic Materials: From Atomic Bonding and Processing to Microstructure, Functional Properties, and Biomedical Applications
summary: Ceramic materials are inorganic, predominantly nonmetallic solids whose performance is governed by the interplay among atomic bonding, crystal structure, processing, microstructure, and functional properties. Their ionic and covalent bonding provides high hardness, thermal and chemical stability, wear resistance, and diverse electrical behavior, but also limits plastic deformation and increases sensitivity to flaws, porosity, grain boundaries, and residual stresses. This review examines ceramics through the processing--microstructure--property--performance relationship, emphasizing the effects of crystal chemistry, defects, grain size, porosity, and phase stability on mechanical, thermal, electrical, and biological behavior. Conventional sintering, sol--gel processing, and additive manufacturing are discussed as key routes for controlling densification, porosity, geometry, and composition. Biomedical ceramics, including alumina, zirconia, calcium phosphates, hydroxyapatite, tricalcium phosphate, and bioactive glasses, are also reviewed. Emerging topics include nanoceramics, smart ceramics, composites, multimaterial manufacturing, defect engineering, immunomodulatory bioceramics, and sustainable processing. Major challenges remain in brittle fracture, processing heterogeneity, degradation control, scale-up, and the porosity--strength trade-off. Future advances will require integrating advanced manufacturing, multiscale characterization, predictive modeling, and data-driven design.

AI.tldr: 该综述以"工艺—微观结构—性能—表现"关系为主线，系统梳理陶瓷材料的键合、结构、缺陷与性能关联，涵盖烧结、溶胶-凝胶与增材制造等工艺，以及生物陶瓷与纳米/智能陶瓷等前沿方向，并指出脆性断裂、工艺不均匀性与孔隙-强度矛盾等核心挑战。
AI.motivation: 陶瓷性能受原子键合、晶体结构、工艺、微观结构与功能特性共同支配，其离子/共价键带来高硬度与稳定性，却导致塑性变形受限、对缺陷与孔隙等高度敏感。为厘清这些复杂关联并指导材料设计，需要系统性的综述框架。
AI.method: 采用综述性分析方法，以"processing–microstructure–property–performance"关系为组织主线，讨论晶体化学、缺陷、晶粒尺寸、孔隙率与相稳定性对力学、热学、电学与生物学行为的影响；并对比常规烧结、溶胶-凝胶与增材制造等工艺路径对致密化、孔隙、几何形状与成分的调控作用。
AI.result: 归纳出陶瓷性能与微观结构要素之间的关联规律；梳理了氧化铝、氧化锆、磷酸钙、羟基磷灰石、磷酸三钙及生物活性玻璃等生物陶瓷；并识别出纳米陶瓷、智能陶瓷、复合材料、多材料制造、缺陷工程、免疫调节生物陶瓷与可持续工艺等新兴主题。
AI.conclusion: 主要挑战仍在于脆性断裂、工艺异质性、降解控制、规模化放大以及孔隙-强度权衡。未来进展需整合先进制造、多尺度表征、预测建模与数据驱动设计，以推动陶瓷材料的设计与应用。

title: Data driven screening of CaCu$_5$-type magnetic structures
summary: We develop a machine learning assisted workflow for the rapid screening of permanent magnet candidates within the CaCu$_5$ structure family. We generated more than 60,000 structures through substitutions. These compositions were screened using a combination of pretrained materials models, Materials Project data, and a machine-learning model for magnetization prediction. Four criteria, namely, metallicity, negative formation energy, energy above the convex hull $\leq 50$~meV/atom, and predicted magnetization above the adopted $\geq 0.75$~T threshold reduced the initial chemical space to 439 candidates for first-principles calculations. Density functional theory calculations revealed that 159 compounds exhibit positive axial magnetic anisotropy energy, favoring [001] over the tested in-plane directions. The resulting dataset reveals chemical trends in magnetic anisotropy across the CaCu$_5$ compositional space and provides a set of candidates for further investigation. More broadly, this work demonstrates a practical strategy for combining existing machine learning models with first-principles calculations to systematically reduce large chemical spaces to tractable sets for computationally intensive materials screening.

AI.tldr: 本文结合机器学习模型与第一性原理计算，在CaCu5结构家族中快速筛选永磁候选材料，将6万余个成分缩减至439个，最终发现159个具有正轴向磁各向异性的化合物。
AI.motivation: 永磁材料候选空间庞大，传统第一性原理计算成本高，需要一种高效策略在巨大的化学空间中快速筛选出可行候选，以降低计算负担。
AI.method: 通过元素替换生成超过60,000个CaCu5结构成分，利用预训练材料模型、Materials Project数据及磁化强度预测机器学习模型进行筛选，采用金属性、负形成能、凸包以上能量≤50 meV/atom、预测磁化强度≥0.75 T四个判据，将其缩减至439个候选并开展DFT计算。
AI.result: 筛选后得到439个候选进行第一性原理计算，其中159个化合物表现出正轴向磁各向异性能，偏好[001]方向；数据集揭示了CaCu5成分空间中磁各向异性的化学趋势。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一批可进一步研究的永磁候选材料，并展示了将现有机器学习模型与第一性原理计算结合、系统缩减巨大化学空间至可计算规模的实用策略。

title: Supercurrent as a bulk probe for topological phase
summary: Distinguishing trivial from topological superconducting phase remains a central and contested experimental challenge, since most existing probes infer the bulk phase transition indirectly, from boundary signatures that can be sensitive to local physics. Here, we propose an alternative that probes the bulk topological phase and is based on supercurrent response. We study a one-dimensional Rashba spin-orbit-coupled superconducting nanowire with an applied magnetic field that opens a topological gap. We show that for strong spin-orbit coupling, the superfluid stiffness, and consequently the supercurrent, is suppressed by a factor of two inside the topological phase, producing a non-monotonic signature of the bulk phase transition as a function of chemical potential. We further use a low-energy helical model to understand this suppression analytically. Our results show that the bulk topological phase transition can be detected through kinetic inductance measurements.

AI.tldr: 本文提出通过超导电流（超流刚度/动力学电感）响应来探测一维Rashba自旋轨道耦合纳米线的体拓扑相变。
AI.motivation: 区分平凡与拓扑超导相是核心且存在争议的实验难题，现有探针多依赖对局域物理敏感的边界信号间接推断体相变，缺乏直接探测体拓扑相的手段。
AI.method: 研究处于外加磁场（打开拓扑能隙）下的一维Rashba自旋轨道耦合超导纳米线，计算其超流刚度与超导电流；并构建低能螺旋（helical）模型进行解析分析。
AI.result: 在强自旋轨道耦合下，进入拓扑相后超流刚度（及超导电流）被压低一半，随化学势变化呈现非单调信号；低能螺旋模型可解析解释该压制现象。
AI.conclusion: 体拓扑相变可通过动力学电感测量（kinetic inductance measurements）加以探测。

title: Magnetic localization and spectral asymmetry of a charged particle at a screw dislocation
summary: We study a charged particle moving outside a spiral (screw) dislocation in a uniform magnetic field. Although the geometry is locally Euclidean, its global screw identification couples the conserved axial and azimuthal quantities through the combination \(\mathcal{J}=\ell-βk\) After eliminating the cyclic coordinates, the radial motion is governed by an inverse-square term determined by $\mathcal{J}$ and a harmonic confining term generated by the magnetic field. The corresponding reduced quantum problem is exactly solvable for $q\mathcal{B}_0\neq0$, yielding an equally spaced spectrum with an orientation-dependent energy shift. The radial probability density depends on $\mathcal{J}$, and opposite values of the screw-modified quantum number have identical spatial profiles but different energies for a fixed magnetic-field orientation. The radial size scales as \(\sqrt{\langle r^2\rangle_n}\propto |q\mathcal{B}_0|^{-1/2}\), with the magnetic length setting the localization scale. At $q\mathcal{B}_0=0$, the confining term vanishes, and the problem reduces to a scale-free inverse-square system. Thus, the screw parameter enters the dynamics through the global coupling of the conserved axial and azimuthal quantities, whereas the magnetic field provides radial confinement and its orientation determines the spectral asymmetry.

AI.tldr: 研究螺旋位错外带电粒子在均匀磁场中的量子运动，发现螺旋参数通过全局耦合轴向与角向守恒量进入动力学，磁场提供径向束缚并决定谱不对称性。
AI.motivation: 探究螺旋（螺型）位错的非平凡全局拓扑如何影响带电粒子在磁场中的运动，尤其是守恒量耦合与能谱结构。
AI.method: 在均匀磁场中求解螺旋位错外部带电粒子的运动；利用局域欧氏但全局螺旋识别的几何，消去循环坐标后得到径向方程，含由耦合量J决定的平方反比项和磁场产生的谐振束缚项，并对约化量子问题进行精确求解。
AI.result: 当qB0≠0时精确可解，得到等间距能谱及依赖取向的能量移动；径向概率密度依赖J；螺旋修正量子数取相反值时空间分布相同但能量不同（固定磁场方向）；径向尺度满足√⟨r²⟩n ∝ |qB0|^{-1/2}，由磁长度设定局域尺度。qB0=0时束缚项消失，退化为无标度平方反比系统。
AI.conclusion: 螺旋参数通过轴向与角向守恒量的全局耦合进入动力学；磁场提供径向束缚，其取向决定谱不对称性。

title: Overcoming the limitations of body-ordered potentials for atomistic machine learning
summary: Machine-learning interatomic potentials have become indispensable tools in atomistic simulations. The most popular models rely heavily on physical priors, such as locality, smoothness and symmetry, that are assumed to improve the accuracy and transferability of the trained models. However, recent evidence suggests that, in the data-rich regime, unconstrained models that learn symmetry from the data can achieve very competitive accuracy and computational efficiency, without sacrificing stability and generalization power. Many equivariant symmetric architectures historically rely on the assumption that the interatomic potential can be approximated well by a convergentcluster expansion, i.e., a decomposition in terms associated to atomic pairs, triplets, quadruplets, and higher-order tuples. We describe an architecture that incorporates locality, smoothness, and symmetry priors, but that -- thanks to a computationally efficient tensor product formulation -- does not assume low-order truncation of the body-ordered series.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种高效张量积表述的机器学习原子间势架构，引入局域性、光滑性和对称性先验，但不假设体序级数的低阶截断。
AI.motivation: 主流机器学习原子间势依赖局域性、光滑性、对称性等物理先验，并常假设互原子势可由收敛的团簇展开近似（即对原子对、三体、四体及更高阶项做低阶截断）。但近期证据显示，在数据充足时，从数据中学习对称性的无约束模型也能达到有竞争力的精度，而许多等变对称架构仍受低阶截断假设的限制。
AI.method: 提出一种架构，结合局域性、光滑性与对称性先验，借助计算效率高的张量积表述，不再假设体序级数的低阶截断。
AI.result: 摘要未提供具体实验数值结果，主要说明该架构在保留物理先验的同时避免了低阶截断假设。
AI.conclusion: 该架构通过高效张量积表述融合物理先验而不依赖低阶体序截断，为机器学习原子间势提供新思路。

title: Theory of Topologically Ordered Superfluids in 2+1 Dimensions
summary: Topologically ordered superfluids (TOSFs) support deconfined, gapped anyonic excitations while remaining gapless because of Goldstone modes. We develop a general framework for characterizing their topological data in $(2+1)$-dimensional bosonic systems with spontaneously broken charge ${\rm U}(1)_{\rm c}$ symmetry. Gauging ${\rm U}(1)_{\rm c}$ maps a TOSF to a gapped topological order enriched by a dual ${\rm U}(1)_{\rm dual}$ symmetry with vanishing Hall conductance, while gauging ${\rm U}(1)_{\rm dual}$ recovers the TOSF. This two-way mapping allows the topological data of the TOSF, including the condensate charge, deconfined anyon content, and topological properties of vortices, to be systematically encoded using the algebraic framework of symmetry-enriched topological orders. In particular, superfluid vortices share the topological properties of flux defects associated with the residual discrete symmetry in the gapped anyon sector. We develop complementary algebraic and field-theoretic formulations of this framework, with the latter also suggesting a natural transition to a gapped topologically ordered phase. Additionally, using parton constructions, we present examples of TOSFs with non-Abelian vortices in bosonic systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个通用框架，通过规范U(1)对称性，用对称富集拓扑序的代数理论来系统刻画拓扑有序超流体的拓扑数据。
AI.motivation: 拓扑有序超流体兼具无能隙的Goldstone模与去禁闭的任意子激发，但其拓扑数据的系统刻画一直缺乏统一框架。
AI.method: 通过规范U(1)_c对称性将TOSF映射为被对偶U(1)_dual对称性富集的、Hall电导为零的有能隙拓扑序，再规范U(1)_dual可还原TOSF；发展了代数与场论两种互补表述，并用parton构造举例。
AI.result: 该双向映射使凝聚电荷、去禁闭任意子内容及涡旋拓扑性质可被系统编码；超流涡旋与残余离散对称性对应的磁通缺陷具有相同拓扑性质；场论表述暗示向有能隙拓扑序的相变；给出了含非阿贝尔涡旋的TOSF例子。
AI.conclusion: 该框架统一了TOSF的拓扑表征，揭示了超流涡旋与对称富集拓扑序中磁通缺陷的对应关系，并可用parton构造实现非阿贝尔涡旋。

title: Omnisolver: An extensible interface to Ising spin-glass and QUBO solvers: adding a distributed GPU brute-force plugin
summary: This software update extends Omnisolver with \texttt{omnisolver-bruteforce}, a first-class plugin for exact exhaustive search of QUBO and Ising instances on CUDA-enabled GPUs. The update contributes three components: packaging of the single-GPU brute-force kernel of [Computer Physics Communications 260, 107728, 2021] as a first-class Omnisolver plugin with a uniform Python and CLI interface, a Ray-based distributed framework that splits the search into $2^{k}$ fixed-variable subproblems and dispatches them across multiple GPUs and hosts, with a controller that gathers and merges partial results, and numerical stabilization of the fast \texttt{float32} ground-state path through compensated incremental updates, periodic exact energy re-anchoring, and best-buffer refresh. Stabilization activates automatically for $N \geq 40$ leaving the public sampler API is unchanged. On dense random Ising instances we measure exhaustive solve times up to $N=60$ on $8\times$ NVIDIA H100 (96 GB) GPUs, reaching $\approx\!3.15$ days at $N=60$ in close agreement with the empirical $t_{N+1}=2\,t_N$ doubling rule, with the distributed sampler reaching the full $\approx\!8\times$ speedup over a single H100 from $N\!\gtrsim\!44$ onwards. The plugin thereby serves as a practical ground-truth oracle for state-of-the-art classical heuristics such as the Simulated Bifurcation Machine.

AI.tldr: 该工作将单GPU暴力搜索CUDA核封装为Omnisolver的一等插件omnisolver-bruteforce，并加入基于Ray的分布式框架与float32数值稳定化，实现对QUBO/Ising实例的精确穷举，在8×H100上可解至N=60。
AI.motivation: 为经典启发式（如Simulated Bifurcation Machine）提供可用的精确ground-truth oracle，需要在GPU上对QUBO/Ising实例做大规模穷举求解，而现有实现缺少统一接口与多GPU/多机扩展能力。
AI.method: 三个组件：(1) 将已有单GPU暴力搜索核封装为Omnisolver插件，提供统一的Python与CLI接口；(2) 基于Ray的分布式框架，把搜索分解为2^k个固定变量子问题并分发到多GPU/多主机，由控制器汇总合并；(3) 通过补偿增量更新、周期性精确能量重锚定与最优缓冲刷新，对float32基态路径做数值稳定化，N≥40自动启用且不改变公共采样器API。
AI.result: 在稠密随机Ising实例上，8×NVIDIA H100(96GB)可穷举至N=60，N=60约需3.15天，符合t_{N+1}=2t_N倍增规律；从N≳44起分布式采样器相对单卡H100达到约8×加速。
AI.conclusion: 该插件可作为实用ground-truth oracle，用于评估最先进的经典启发式算法。

title: Axiomatic Incompatibility Between Thermal Equilibrium and Volume-Dependent Entropy in Ideal Gas Theory
summary: A rigorous macroscopic analysis of classical thermodynamics reveals an overlooked contradiction at the foundations of ideal gas theory: the traditional volume dependent formula for entropy violates the fundamental axiom of thermal equilibrium during reversible isothermal processes. This paper resolves this inconsistency by establishing a strict operational distinction between strictly isothermal and quasi isothermal processes. We show that in order for the perfect gas to be strictly consistent with the laws of classical thermodynamics, the thermodynamic entropy of a perfect gas must be a function of temperature only. This independence of volume is also confirmed by a new analysis of the adiabatic free expansion of an ideal gas, which is found to be intrinsically reversible. To reconcile these results with standard thermodynamic practice, we introduce the concept of a pseudo isothermal process (a finite sequence of small adiabatic and isochoric steps) and show that the classical equations for work and heat apply rigorously to these real processes, as opposed to strictly isothermal ones. We conclude by discussing the profound implications of these findings for statistical mechanics, showing that while the corrected thermodynamic entropy is in perfect agreement with Maxwell's kinetic theory, it is essentially different from the Planck Boltzmann formula. Thus, thermodynamic entropy and statistical microstate counting are two different physical quantities, and the present analysis provides a simple way to free classical thermodynamics from the paradoxes of microscopic disorder.

AI.tldr: 本文指出理想气体熵的传统体积依赖公式违反热平衡公理，主张完美气体的热力学熵仅是温度的函数，并区分严格等温与准等温过程，提出"伪等温过程"概念，最后指出该熵与普朗克-玻尔兹曼公式本质不同。
AI.motivation: 经典热力学中理想气体熵的传统体积依赖公式在可逆等温过程中违反热平衡基本公理，存在被忽视的基础性矛盾，需要严格分析并解决这一不一致。
AI.method: 严格宏观分析；区分严格等温与准等温过程；重新分析绝热自由膨胀（认为其本质可逆）；引入"伪等温过程"（由小绝热步与等容步组成的有限序列）来调和与标准热力学实践的关系。
AI.result: 为与经典热力学定律严格一致，完美气体的热力学熵必须仅是温度的函数，与体积无关；经典功与热公式严格适用于伪等温过程而非严格等温过程；修正后的热力学熵与麦克斯韦动理论一致，但与普朗克-玻尔兹曼公式本质不同。
AI.conclusion: 热力学熵与统计微观态计数是两种不同的物理量；该分析为经典热力学摆脱微观无序悖论提供了简单途径。

title: Band Tail States: Speed Bump or End of the Road for Two-Dimensional Semiconductors?
summary: We propose that the path to realizing the full potential of two-dimensional (2D) electronics lies in understanding and mastering their energy band tail states (BTS). Unlike silicon, which benefits from sharp band edges (Urbach energy $E_\rm U$ ~ 10 meV), today's monolayer 2D semiconductors have rough band edges ($E_\rm U$ ~ 100 meV) caused by spatial potential inhomogeneity. Comparing a physics-based electrical model to experiments, we demonstrate that BTS cause reduced effective mobility and "slow" transistor turn-on with excessive gate voltage in monolayer 2D transistors, which sets a fundamental limit for their energy-efficient operation. We also show that BTS effects in 2D transistors could be mitigated with higher gate capacitance, with strain engineering, and by using bilayer instead of monolayer 2D channels, as long as $E_\rm U$ is reduced below ~ 50 meV. This work provides a theoretical framework and design guidelines to navigate these fundamental limits, and to enable successful integration of 2D semiconductors into low-power nanoelectronics.

AI.tldr: 二维电子学发展的关键在于理解并掌控能带尾态(BTS)。单层二维半导体的粗糙能带边缘($E_\rm U$~100 meV)会造成有效迁移率降低和晶体管"慢"开启，限制能效工作。通过更高栅电容、应变工程及双层沟道可缓解BTS效应，但需将$E_\rm U$降至~50 meV以下。
AI.motivation: 当前单层二维半导体受空间电势不均匀影响，能带边缘粗糙($E_\rm U$~100 meV)，远差于硅(~10 meV)。这一能带尾态(BTS)问题成为限制二维电子学能效工作的根本瓶颈，因此需深入理解并加以掌控。
AI.method: 将基于物理的电学模型与实验对比，分析BTS对单层二维晶体管性能的影响，并探讨抑制BTS效应的可能途径。
AI.result: BTS导致有效迁移率降低，并使晶体管需过大栅压才"慢"开启，成为能效工作的根本限制。通过提高栅电容、应变工程以及用双层替代单层二维沟道，可在$E_\rm U$低于~50 meV时缓解BTS效应。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了理论框架与设计指南，帮助应对这些根本限制，推动二维半导体成功集成到低功耗纳电子学中。

title: Amplitude mode in Eliashberg superconductors
summary: In the BCS theory of superconductivity the amplitude (Higgs) mode is degenerate with the pair-breaking threshold: its frequency coincides with $2Δ$, so it is an edge singularity rather than a true collective mode. This is why after a sudden weak perturbation at $t=0$ its oscillations decay algebraically as $1/\sqrt{t}$. We show that the retardation effects due to the phonon dynamics in the strong-coupling theory lift this degeneracy. The Higgs mode detaches from the pair-breaking edge $2Δ_g$, set by the spectral gap, and becomes a sharp subgap excitation. We determine its frequency from the longitudinal pair susceptibility evaluated directly on the real frequency axis, using the Eilenberger equations for Migdal--Eliashberg theory with the Einstein phonon spectrum. The response of the mass renormalization supplies at least two fifths of the displacement, and possibly all of it: with it switched off, the binding falls below the resolution of the calculation. Its consequences, however, are significant because a percent-level shift transfers about a quarter of the spectral weight of the amplitude channel out of the two-quasiparticle continuum into a discrete energy level. What experiment sees is therefore not the displacement itself but its consequence: amplitude oscillations that persist instead of decaying as $1/\sqrt{t}$.

AI.tldr: 在强耦合Migdal- Eliashberg理论下，声子动力学导致的延迟效应会解除BCS理论中Higgs模与配对破坏阈值2Δ的简并，使之脱离连续谱成为尖锐的亚能隙集体激发；该位移虽小（约百分之几），却把约四分之一的振幅谱权转入分立能级，从而表现为不衰减的振幅振荡。
AI.motivation: BCS理论中Higgs（振幅）模与配对破坏阈值简并，频率等于2Δ，只是一个边缘奇异而非真正的集体模，因此在弱扰动下振荡按1/√t代数衰减。作者希望探究强耦合理论中的声子延迟效应能否解除这一简并，使Higgs模成为真正的亚能隙集体激发。
AI.method: 使用Migdal- Eliashberg理论的Eilenberger方程，配合Einstein声子谱，直接在实频率轴上计算纵向配对感受率，以此确定Higgs模频率，并分析质量重整化对位移的贡献。
AI.result: 延迟效应使Higgs模从谱隙决定的2Δ_g处脱离，成为尖锐的亚能隙激发。质量重整化的响应贡献了至少五分之二的位移（可能全部）；若关闭该效应，结合能低于计算分辨率。位移虽仅百分之几量级，却将振幅通道约四分之一的谱权从双准粒子连续谱转移到分立能级。
AI.conclusion: 实验观测到的并非位移本身，而是其后果：振幅振荡持续存在，而非按1/√t衰减。这表明Higgs模在强耦合超导体中可作为真正的亚能隙集体模被探测。

title: Millisecond phonon lifetimes in piezoelectric nanomechanical resonators
summary: Piezoelectric nanomechanical resonators operating at gigahertz frequencies are a promising platform for quantum information processing and precision sensing, but phonon lifetimes have been limited to the microsecond range, widely attributed to the higher intrinsic loss of piezoelectric materials. Here we show that this limitation is not fundamental. Using a fabrication process informed by recent studies of defect-mediated loss in lithium niobate, we combine chemical restoration of ion-milled surfaces with a shadow-mask metallization process to produce lithium niobate phononic crystal resonators with inferred internal phonon lifetimes of up to 21 milliseconds at 3.6 gigahertz, corresponding to quality factors exceeding $4\times10^8$ ($f\cdot Q_i > 10^{18}$) at millikelvin temperatures. By systematically varying the electrode-to-resonator spacing, we demonstrate that the measured lifetime is set by external coupling between the device and the measurement circuit rather than material loss. This establishes that lithium niobate, once fabrication-induced surface damage is removed, achieves an intrinsic quality comparable to the best mechanical materials while remaining an intrinsically piezoelectric platform with strong electromechanical coupling.

AI.tldr: 通过化学修复离子铣削表面并结合阴影掩模金属化工艺，制备出铌酸锂声子晶体谐振器，在3.6 GHz下推断出声子寿命高达21毫秒（Qi > 4×10^8），证明此前微秒级寿命限制并非压电材料本征属性，而是由测量电路外部耦合决定。
AI.motivation: GHz频段压电纳米机械谐振器在量子信息处理与精密传感中前景广阔，但其声子寿命长期限于微秒量级，被普遍归因于压电材料较高的本征损耗。作者希望检验这一限制是否真的不可突破。
AI.method: 基于近期对铌酸锂缺陷介导损耗的研究，采用化学修复离子铣削损伤表面的方法，结合阴影掩模金属化工艺，制备铌酸锂声子晶体谐振器；并在毫开尔文温度下，通过系统改变电极与谐振器间距来区分本征损耗与外部耦合。
AI.result: 在3.6 GHz下推断出内部声子寿命最高达21毫秒，对应品质因子超过4×10^8（f·Qi > 10^18）；随电极-谐振器间距变化表明测得寿命由器件与测量电路的外部耦合决定，而非材料损耗。
AI.conclusion: 铌酸锂在去除制造引入的表面损伤后，其本征质量可与最佳机械材料相媲美，同时仍保持强机电耦合的本征压电平台，说明此前的寿命限制并非根本性的。

title: Ab Initio Investigation of Excited States and Absorption Spectra of Small Mercury Clusters (Hg$_{2-5}$)
summary: We report a systematic \textit{ab initio} investigation of the excited states and absorption spectra of small mercury clusters (Hg$_{\mathrm{2-5}}$). Benchmarking multi-reference configuration interaction (MR-CISD) and equation-of-motion coupled-cluster (EOM-CCSD) methods shows that EOM-CCSD/aug-cc-PVTZ-PP reproduces atomic excitation energies within $\pm$500 cm$^{-1}$ of experiment, whereas MR-CISD deviates by about $\pm$1100 cm$^{-1}$. For the mercury dimer, EOM-CCSD potential energy curves yield absorption bands in excellent agreement with experimental transitions, while asymptotic excitation energies closely match atomic references. Extending this methodology, we present the first systematic \textit{ab initio} study of absorption spectra of Hg$_{\mathrm{3}}$, Hg$_{\mathrm{4}}$, Hg$_{\mathrm{5}}$, which display broad bands in the ranges of 37000-60000 cm$^{-1}$. The consistent agreement with experimental benchmarks and diagnostics confirming single-reference character validates EOM-CCSD as a robust approach for describing excited states and optical spectra of mercury clusters.

AI.tldr: 本文用MR-CISD与EOM-CCSD对小汞团簇(Hg2-5)的激发态和吸收光谱进行系统从头计算，发现EOM-CCSD/aug-cc-PVTZ-PP精度更高，并首次系统研究了Hg3-5的吸收光谱。
AI.motivation: 需要评估并验证能可靠描述汞团簇激发态与光学光谱的方法，以支持对更大汞团簇的研究。
AI.method: 采用多参考组态相互作用(MR-CISD)与运动方程耦合簇(EOM-CCSD)方法，结合aug-cc-PVTZ-PP基组，计算Hg2-5的激发能、势能曲线及吸收光谱，并作单参考特征诊断。
AI.result: EOM-CCSD重现原子激发能误差约±500 cm⁻¹，优于MR-CISD(约±1100 cm⁻¹)；Hg2吸收带与实验吻合；Hg3-5呈现37000-60000 cm⁻¹的宽带吸收，且诊断确认其单参考特征。
AI.conclusion: EOM-CCSD是描述汞团簇激发态和光学光谱的稳健方法。

title: SC$^\sharp$: superconductivity intertwined with topological order
summary: Superconductivity and intrinsic topological order can intertwine in ways that go beyond simple coexistence. Here we develop a classification framework for (2+1)D gapped superconductors with condensate charge $2ne$. By focusing on the topological properties of superconducting vortices, we precisely characterize this interplay. We obtain a classification with increasing levels of intertwinement, from the well known invertible superconductors without topological order, to untwisted and twisted SC$^\ast$, and finally to SC$^{\sharp}$. Our main finding is the family SC$^{\sharp}$, in which the elementary vortex carrying $h/(2ne)$ flux cannot be factorized into an invertible superconductor vortex dressed by bulk anyons, and every elementary vortex is necessarily non-Abelian. For such phases, we also obtain no-go results: the elementary vortex sector has quantum dimension at least $\sqrt{6}$ and cannot satisfy Fibonacci fusion rules. We develop a systematic algebraic framework to obtain all these superconducting phases through anyon condensation, allowing us to construct several infinite families of examples and make connections to anyon superconductivity. Finally, we introduce primitive SC$^\sharp$ phases for which factorization of every nontrivial vortex sector is obstructed, and argue that they cannot arise by disordering the relative phases of lower-charge superconducting condensates. Our classification scheme based on vortex properties allows us to uncover new distinctions between topologically ordered superconductors and constrain how they can be realized.

AI.tldr: 本文为(2+1)维凝聚电荷为$2ne$的能隙超导体建立分类框架，从涡旋拓扑性质出发刻画超导性与内禀拓扑序的交织，发现新的SC$^{\sharp}$家族并给出相关no-go约束。
AI.motivation: 超导性与内禀拓扑序的交织可能超出简单共存，但缺乏系统分类框架来精确刻画这种交织及其层次。
AI.method: 聚焦超导涡旋的拓扑性质，建立基于涡旋属性的分类方案；通过任意子凝聚发展系统代数框架来构造这些超导相。
AI.result: 得到按交织程度递增的分类：无拓扑序的可逆超导体、untwisted与twisted SC$^\ast$、以及SC$^{\sharp}$。SC$^{\sharp}$中携带$h/(2ne)$磁通的元涡旋不可分解为可逆超导涡旋加体任意子，且每个元涡旋必为非阿贝尔。no-go结果：元涡旋区量子维数至少$\sqrt{6}$，不能满足Fibonacci融合规则。构造多族无穷例子，并联系任意子超导。
AI.conclusion: 引入primitive SC$^{\sharp}$相，其每个非平凡涡旋区分解均受阻，且不能由较低电荷超导凝聚体的相对相位无序化得到。该分类揭示了拓扑有序超导体间的新区别并约束其实现方式。

title: Fast Angular Sweep Monostatic Radar Cross Section Computation via Model Order Reduction
summary:
The radar cross section (RCS) is a fundamental parameter in radar engineering, as it determines the detectability of a given target by a radar system. Increasing interest in very low observability (VLO) targets has arisen recently. As a result, especial effort is put in developing numerical tools to accurately predict the electromagnetic scattering from perfect electric conductor objects. Integral equation methods are commonly used in this task. However, full-wave computation of the monostatic RCS at a single angle can be rather time-consuming, nevermind computing the RCS in a specific angular interval with a fine sampling. In fact, this is what is needed in industrial applications.
  A reduced-order model for fast full-wave monostatic RCS evaluation is proposed to easily achieve fine details in the desired angular domain. An open source integral equation solver, taken into account as a black box, is used to get the electromagnetic scattering in non-penetrable objects at some specific incident angles. Several radar targets will show the possibilities and capabilities of these model order reduction approaches.

AI.tldr: 提出一种降阶模型，用于快速全波计算单站RCS，在目标角度区间实现精细采样。
AI.motivation: 低可观测目标研究需求增加，需精确预测理想导体电磁散射；工业应用要求在特定角度区间精细采样计算单站RCS，但现有全波积分方程方法单角度计算耗时，全区间精细采样不可行。
AI.method: 采用降阶模型，将开源积分方程求解器视为黑盒，在若干特定入射角获取非穿透目标的电磁散射数据，据此构建模型以实现快速RCS评估。
AI.result: 在多个雷达目标上验证，展示了该模型降阶方法实现快速单站RCS评估的可能性与能力。
AI.conclusion: 该降阶模型可高效获得目标角度域内的精细RCS细节，满足工业应用对快速全波单站RCS计算的需求。

title: Efficiency fluctuations in quantum heat engines with non-quasi-static adiabatic strokes
summary: We have presented an analytical and numerical study of efficiency fluctuations in quantum Carnot and Otto engines with pistons operating under non-quasi-static adiabatic expansion and compression processes at constant speed, along with quasi-static isothermal (for the Carnot engine) or isochoric processes (for the Otto engine). We have considered the two-point measurement scheme during the adiabatic strokes in this regard. By considering each of the pistons as a single quantum particle in a 1-D box with a non-quasi-statically movable boundary, we capture the stochastic nature of the work output resulting from the unitary evolution of the quantum mechanical state of the system during non-equilibrium processes. Furthermore, we have explicitly shown how the piston speed during quantum non-equilibrium strokes introduces additional quantum fluctuations that modify the average efficiency of both the engines.

AI.tldr: 本文研究量子卡诺与奥托引擎在非准静态绝热膨胀/压缩过程中的效率涨落，将活塞视为一维势箱中的量子粒子，揭示活塞速度引入的额外量子涨落会修正两引擎的平均效率。
AI.motivation: 量子热力学中，实际绝热冲程往往快速进行而非准静态，现有研究对非准静态绝热过程如何影响效率涨落及平均效率的刻画不足，尤其缺乏对活塞速度这一关键因素的量子处理。
AI.method: 结合解析与数值方法，对量子卡诺与奥托引擎建模：等温（卡诺）或等容（奥托）过程为准静态，绝热膨胀与压缩为恒速非准静态过程；采用两点测量方案；将每个活塞视为带可移动边界的一维势箱中的单量子粒子，通过系统量子态的幺正演化刻画功输出的随机性。
AI.result: 在绝热冲程中非平衡幺正演化导致功输出呈随机分布，活塞速度在非平衡冲程中引入额外量子涨落，并显著改变两引擎的平均效率。
AI.conclusion: 非准静态绝热过程及活塞速度是决定量子热机效率涨落与平均效率的重要因素，两个引擎的效率均因此被修正，表明量子非平衡效应对量子热机性能有可量化影响。

title: Bond-Switching Reconstruction in Bare Ti3C2 MXene
summary: MXene properties are typically tuned through composition, surface termination, and intercalation, while the metal-carbon framework topology is considered fixed. Here, we demonstrate that this framework can reconstruct. Unconstrained relaxations of biaxially strained bare Ti3C2 yield a dynamically stable polymorph, N, featuring a 15-atom primitive cell, six distinct Ti-C bond classes, and 2.55 Å Ti-Ti pairs. The coherent transformation pathway crosses an 8.47 eV barrier per cell but first reaches another reconstructed minimum, N', lying 1.08 eV below N, revealing a family of bond-switched networks. Phase N lies 7.58 eV per cell above the parent. Reverse barriers along the calculated pathway are 1.50 and 1.98 eV per cell for N and N', respectively. Reconstruction quenches the parent spin polarization, yielding a nonmagnetic metal with a nearly fourfold increase in Fermi-level density of states. Bader and electron-localization analyses suggest charge redistribution from C toward Ti associated with Ti-Ti pairing. In multilayers, reconstructed layers form interlayer Ti-C bonds. A 10% biaxial tension halves the phase-energy difference, and pressure reverses phase ordering near 85 GPa. These results establish bond-switching reconstruction as a mechanically controllable structural degree of freedom in MXenes.

AI.tldr: 该文证明MXene的金属-碳骨架拓扑并非固定，双轴应变下Ti3C2可发生键切换重构形成新多晶型。
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为MXene性质调控仅依赖成分、表面终止和插层，而金属-碳骨架拓扑被视为固定不变；作者希望检验该骨架能否发生重构。
AI.method: 对双轴应变下的裸Ti3C2进行无约束弛豫，获得亚稳多晶型N（15原子原胞、6类Ti-C键、2.55 Å Ti-Ti对），计算其相变路径与势垒、磁性、电子结构（Bader与电子局域化分析），并考察多层结构、拉伸与压力影响。
AI.result: 发现重构路径先到达比N低1.08 eV/cell的中间极小N'，形成键切换网络家族；N比母相高7.58 eV/cell；正向势垒8.47 eV/cell，反向势垒1.50和1.98 eV/cell；重构淬灭自旋极化，形成非磁金属，费米面态密度近增四倍；电荷由C向Ti转移并伴随Ti-Ti配对；多层中重构层形成层间Ti-C键；10%双轴拉伸使相能差减半，约85 GPa压力反转相序。
AI.conclusion: 键切换重构是MXene中一种可由力学调控的结构自由度。

title: High Efficiency in Large Supercurrent Rectification with Superconducting Coil
summary: Superconducting diodes (SDs) are devices that rectify supercurrent through the difference in the superconducting critical current (Ic) between forward and reverse current directions. For bringing such SDs closer to practical superconducting power electronics applications, a combination of both high rectification efficiency (η) and a large Ic difference (ΔIc) is required. Here, we propose and demonstrate a coil-shaped superconducting wire device concept to induce a large SD effect, arising from the compensation between an external magnetic field (Hext) and the field generated by the coil itself. From transport Ic measurements on coil-shaped SDs based on a Sn10-Pb90 solder wire, we achieved a η of 79% with a ΔIc of 140 A at Hext = 500 Oe (coil #2) and a η of 84% with a ΔIc of 125 A at Hext = 530 Oe (coil #3), confirming high rectification values at large supercurrents. The large-current high-efficiency SDE in the coil-shaped SDs will be highly useful for developing the potential field of supercurrent power electronics.

AI.tldr: 提出并验证线圈形超导焊料线器件，通过外磁场与线圈自场的补偿效应实现大电流高效率超导二极管效应。
AI.motivation: 超导二极管走向超导功率电子实用化，需要同时具备高整流效率(η)和大临界电流差(ΔIc)。
AI.method: 设计线圈形超导线器件，利用外部磁场(Hext)与线圈自身产生磁场的补偿来诱导大的超导二极管效应；对基于Sn10-Pb90焊料的线圈形器件进行输运Ic测量。
AI.result: 线圈#2：Hext=500 Oe下 η=79%，ΔIc=140 A；线圈#3：Hext=530 Oe下 η=84%，ΔIc=125 A，证实大超电流下仍具高整流性能。
AI.conclusion: 该大电流高效率的线圈形超导二极管效应有助于推动超电流功率电子这一潜在领域的发展。

title: Hydrodynamic Anomalous Hall Effect in a Two-Dimensional Dirac Fluid
summary: In ultraclean conductors, electron-electron collisions can make transport hydrodynamic. In a Berry-curved band, these collisions can also produce two-particle coordinate shifts, which contribute to the anomalous Hall current in the presence of a transport electric field. We develop a kinetic theory of this contribution for a two-dimensional massive Dirac Fermi liquid with weak contact interactions and weak short-range disorder. The computed response is independent of interaction strength at leading Born order. Its contribution to the anomalous Hall conductivity is comparable to the thermal correction to the intrinsic anomalous Hall conductivity. The existence of the momentum zero mode of the electron-electron collision integral leads to a nontrivial frequency dependence of the anomalous Hall response considered in this work. In particular, the limits of vanishing frequency (dc) and vanishing disorder do not commute. In the dc limit, the momentum response to the transport field grows inversely with the momentum relaxation rate. This allows arbitrarily weak, energy-dependent impurity scattering to produce a finite correction by coupling conserved momentum to the modes relaxed by electron-electron scattering. This correction disappears when the clean limit is taken before the zero-frequency limit. As a result, the interaction-induced Hall response retains information about the mechanism of momentum relaxation even as the overall disorder strength tends to zero.

AI.tldr: 本文为二维有质量狄拉克费米液体（弱接触相互作用、弱短程无序）发展动力学理论，研究电子-电子碰撞产生的双粒子坐标移动对反常霍尔电流的贡献。
AI.motivation: 在超洁净导体中电子-电子碰撞使输运呈流体力学行为；在贝里曲率带中，这些碰撞还会产生双粒子坐标移动，从而在输运电场下贡献反常霍尔电流。此前缺乏对此贡献的动力学理论描述。
AI.method: 建立二维有质量狄拉克费米液体的动力学理论，考虑弱接触相互作用与弱短程无序，计算反常霍尔响应，并分析其对相互作用强度、无序、频率的依赖及动量零模的影响。
AI.result: 在主导玻恩阶，响应与相互作用强度无关；其对反常霍尔电导的贡献可与本征反常霍尔电导的热修正相比拟。电子-电子碰撞积分的动量零模导致响应对频率有非平凡依赖：dc极限与洁净极限不可交换；dc极限下动量响应随动量弛豫率反比增长，任意弱的能量依赖杂质散射都能产生有限修正；若先取洁净极限则该修正消失。
AI.conclusion: 相互作用诱导的霍尔响应即使总无序强度趋于零，仍保留动量弛豫机制的信息。

title: Visualizing Three-Dimensional Quantum Fluctuations of Ground-State C$_3$H$_4$ via Deep Sub-Angstrom Coulomb Explosion Imaging
summary: Coulomb explosion imaging (CEI) is a powerful tool for determining static geometries of isolated gas-phase molecules. In this work, taking allene and propyne as prototype, we demonstrate sub-angstrom resolution achieved with highly charged ion-induced CEI. Using 41.9 keV/u Xe$^{20+}$ beam, minute variations of CC single, double and triple bond lengths are clearly visualized, indicating that an ultrahigh resolution of 0.1 $\mathring{\mathrm{A}}$ is achieved. This unprecedented resolution not only makes it possible to distinguish CC bonds with different bond orders, but also lays a solid foundation for direct observation of quantum fluctuations inherent to 3D structure of a ground-state molecule. Notably, the coupled collective motion of the two CH$_2$ moieties spaced by a central carbon within allene is unambiguously visualized in our measurements.

AI.tldr: 本文利用高电荷态离子诱导的库仑爆炸成像（CEI），在丙二烯和丙炔上实现了0.1 Å超高分辨率，可区分不同键级的C-C键，并观察到丙二烯中两个CH₂基团的耦合集体运动。
AI.motivation: CEI是测定孤立气相分子静态几何结构的有力工具，但需要在键长测量上获得足够高的分辨率以区分不同键级的化学键并观测基态分子的量子涨落。
AI.method: 采用41.9 keV/u的Xe²⁰⁺高电荷态离子束诱导CEI，以丙二烯和丙炔为原型分子，通过测量碎片离子反推分子几何结构。
AI.result: 实现了0.1 Å的超高分辨率，清晰分辨出C-C单键、双键和三键键长的微小差异；并明确观测到丙二烯中被中心碳分隔的两个CH₂基团的耦合集体运动。
AI.conclusion: 高电荷态离子诱导CEI达到亚埃级分辨率，不仅能区分不同键级的C-C键，还为直接观测基态分子三维结构固有的量子涨落奠定了基础。

title: Spin Chain with Continuous Exponential Symmetry: Topological Phase and Beyond
summary: We study symmetric gapped ground states of one-dimensional spin $S$ chains with a continuous exponential symmetry $U(1)\rtimes\mathbb Z_2$ with integer base $q$, where the U(1) charge has a modulated unit of charge $q^{L-j}$ decaying exponentially with site $j$. The simplest model is a quantum breakdown model that can be viewed as a $q$-deformation of the XXZ Haldane spin chain. We show that the topology of their symmetric ground states crucially depends on $S$ and $q$. For integer $S$, odd $q$ allows a nontrivial $\mathbb Z_2$ Haldane-type symmetry-protected topological (SPT) phase with protected edge modes, while even $q$ allows no nontrivial SPT phase. For half-odd integer $S$, odd $q$ prohibits any unique symmetric gapped ground state due to a Lieb-Schultz-Mattis obstruction, whereas even $q$ enforces a novel symmetric gapped phase which we name as the ``half-SPT" phase. Unconventionally, the half-SPT phase only has a symmetry protected edge mode on one edge, and has half of the string orders of an SPT phase. Our results uncover a new type of symmetry-protected gapped phases beyond existing classification schemes.

AI.tldr: 研究具有 $U(1)\rtimes\mathbb Z_2$ 指数对称性的一维自旋链对称基态拓扑，发现对称性拓扑取决于自旋 $S$ 与模数 $q$，并提出超越现有分类的新奇“半-SPT”相。
AI.motivation: 现有对称保护拓扑（SPT）分类框架难以描述具有指数衰减调制连续对称性的体系，需要探索这类新对称性下对称有能隙基态的拓扑类型。
AI.method: 研究一维自旋 $S$ 链在整数基底 $q$ 的 $U(1)\rtimes\mathbb Z_2$ 连续指数对称性下的对称有能隙基态；以可视为 XXZ Haldane 链 $q$-变形的量子击穿模型作为最简模型进行分析。
AI.result: 拓扑取决于 $S$ 和 $q$：整数 $S$ 时，奇 $q$ 支持带受保护边缘模的非平凡 $\mathbb Z_2$ Haldane 型 SPT 相，偶 $q$ 无；半奇整数 $S$ 时，奇 $q$ 因 Lieb-Schultz-Mattis 阻碍不存在唯一对称有能隙基态，偶 $q$ 强制形成新“半-SPT”相，仅一侧有对称保护边缘模且弦序为 SPT 的一半。
AI.conclusion: 揭示了超越现有分类方案的一类新对称保护有能隙相，即半-SPT 相。

title: Ghost tasking for parametrized Gaussian Processes solving linear differential equations
summary: Physics-informed machine learning has gained significant attention in recent years. In regimes of limited data, parametrized Gaussian processes have become popular. Existing approaches, however, often face limitations, such as requiring parametrizable (also called controllable) systems or a large number of output tasks. In this work, we introduce a systematic procedure we call "ghost tasking", using auxiliary tasks to circumvent these limitations. We prove that such ghost tasks can render any non-parametrizable system effectively parametrizable, enabling algorithmic construction of parametrized Gaussian Processes while keeping the number of required tasks (i.e. output dimensions) and latent functions low. We find that ghost tasking performs especially well in an inverse problem setting, even with very few available data. We show the usage and power of ghost tasking in three experiments, providing systematic comparisons to the only other currently available method applicable to all experiments. We provide necessary syntax and explications for two computer algebra programs that compute parametrizations for systems with polynomial or rational coefficients. Our theoretical results extend to systems with meromorphic functions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"ghost tasking"方法，利用辅助任务使任意非可参数化系统变得可参数化，从而构建参数化高斯过程，且所需任务数与潜在函数数量少。
AI.motivation: 现有参数化高斯过程方法存在局限：要求系统可参数化（可控）或需要大量输出任务。
AI.method: 引入"ghost tasking"系统化流程，使用辅助任务（ghost tasks）来绕过上述限制，并证明其可使任意非可参数化系统有效可参数化；提供针对多项式/有理系数系统的计算机代数程序语法。
AI.result: 证明ghost tasks使系统有效可参数化，保持任务数与潜在函数数量低；在逆问题场景中表现尤佳，即使数据极少。通过三个实验与现有唯一可比方法进行系统比较。
AI.conclusion: Ghost tasking有效突破现有参数化高斯过程的限制，理论结果可推广至亚纯函数系统。

title: A general framework for crystallization in maximal hard-core models
summary: We study general maximal hard-core models on periodic lattice-type graphs. While for standard models, phase coexistence may arise for high activity, for maximal models this behavior may occur also for sufficiently low activity values. Relying on the concept of volume allocation, we develop a {\em unified set of assumptions} that imply the Peierls condition, a convergent cluster expansion for the partition function, and hence the conclusions of Pirogov-Sinai theory for this class of models. We further check these assumptions for a number of examples including standard lattice-type periodic graphs, proving crystallization for both high and low activity. We also derive estimates for the values of activity that bound the phase coexistence regions in the phase diagram, rewriting for this purpose the proof of a technical result in the derivation of Pirogov-Sinai theory.

AI.tldr: 研究周期格型图上的一般最大硬核模型，借助体积分配概念建立统一假设，推出Peierls条件与收敛的团簇展开，从而应用Pirogov-Sinai理论，涵盖高、低活度下的相变共存与结晶。
AI.motivation: 标准硬核模型相共存通常出现在高活度，而最大模型在低活度也可能出现相共存，需要统一框架来刻画此类现象并验证其相变行为。
AI.method: 引入体积分配（volume allocation）概念，提出一组统一假设，证明其可推出Peierls条件与配分函数的收敛团簇展开，进而应用Pirogov-Sinai理论；并重写Pirogov-Sinai理论中一个技术性结果的证明以估计活度边界。
AI.result: 在标准格型周期图等若干例子中验证了假设，证明了高活度与低活度下的结晶现象，并给出界定相共存区域活度取值的估计。
AI.conclusion: 建立了适用于一般最大硬核模型的统一Pirogov-Sinai分析框架，统一处理高、低活度下的相共存与结晶，并给出相图中相共存区域的活度估计。

title: Light-induced interlayer spacing dynamics via orbital phonon coupling
summary: Interlayer coupling controls the electronic properties of layered van der Waals transition metal dichalcogenides. We investigate light-induced control of the interlayer spacing through orbital-selective excitation in trilayer 1T'-WSe2 and 1T'-WS2. Real-time time-dependent density functional theory simulations show that the interlayer spacing contracts or expands depending on whether chalcogen p-orbital density is depleted from or accumulated in the interlayer region. Effective Lindblad models coupled to the lattice dynamics reproduce these contrasting responses with simplified dynamics. A single effective excited state captures the cosine-like displacive motion in trilayer 1T'-WSe2, whereas the shift of the equilibrium spacing in trilayer 1T'-WS2 requires two excited states with different electron-phonon couplings and relaxation channels. Static calculations at varied interlayer spacings indicate that these spacing changes modify the electronic gaps and could access different electronic phases. These results connect orbital redistribution, carrier relaxation, and interlayer breathing motion, and establish orbital-selective optical excitation as a route to tuning the electronic properties of layered materials.

AI.tldr: 通过轨道选择性激发可在三层1T'-WSe2和1T'-WS2中光控层间距（收缩或膨胀），并据此调节电子能隙与相态。
AI.motivation: 层间耦合决定范德华过渡金属硫族化合物的电子性质，因此需要找到主动调控层间距的手段，并理解轨道激发、载流子弛豫与层间呼吸运动之间的联系。
AI.method: 采用实时含时密度泛函理论（rt-TDDFT）模拟轨道选择性激发下的层间动力学，并结合有效Lindblad模型与晶格动力学；辅以不同层间距的静态计算。
AI.result: 层间距收缩或膨胀取决于硫族p轨道密度在层间区域被耗尽还是积累；1T'-WSe2表现为单一有效激发态驱动的余弦型位移运动，1T'-WS2则需两个具有不同电声耦合与弛豫通道的激发态；层间距变化改变电子能隙，可实现不同电子相。
AI.conclusion: 轨道选择性光激发可作为调控层状材料电子性质的有效途径，将轨道重分布、载流子弛豫与层间呼吸运动统一起来。

title: Strain-engineered long-distance supercurrent in an altermagnetic CrSb based-Josephson junction
summary: Altermagnetic materials, characterized by vanishing net magnetization and momentum-dependent spin splitting, provide a unique platform for realizing unconventional superconducting states without the detrimental stray fields. Here, we demonstrate long-distance Josephson supercurrent transport through epitaxial thin films of the strained altermagnet CrSb. We observe a dissipationless supercurrent across a lateral spacer distance of 150 nm in a CrSb-based Josephson junction, exceeding the conventional spin-singlet coherence length by nearly two orders of magnitude. This supercurrent is further accompanied by a well-defined magnetic-field-induced quantum interference pattern, providing direct evidence for genuine Josephson coupling. Our results reveal altermagnets as a promising route toward generating long-distance supercurrents without macroscopic magnetic stray fields, opening new opportunities for superconducting spintronic applications.

AI.tldr: 在应变交替磁体CrSb外延薄膜中实现了跨150 nm的超导约瑟夫森电流输运，远超常规自旋单态相干长度近两个数量级，为无杂散场的超导自旋电子学提供新途径。
AI.motivation: 交替磁体具有零净磁化与动量依赖的自旋劈裂，可规避杂散场的不利影响，是探索非常规超导态的独特平台。
AI.method: 制备应变交替磁体CrSb外延薄膜，构建横向约瑟夫森结，在150 nm间隔距离上测量无耗散超电流，并观测磁场诱导的量子干涉图样。
AI.result: 在CrSb基约瑟夫森结中观测到跨150 nm间隔的无耗散超电流，超过常规自旋单态相干长度近两个数量级，并伴随清晰的磁场诱导量子干涉图样，证实存在真正的约瑟夫森耦合。
AI.conclusion: 交替磁体可在无宏观杂散场条件下产生长距离超电流，为超导自旋电子学应用开辟新机遇。

title: EPR as a probe for the mechanisms of chirality-induced spin selectivity in photoinduced charge transfer
summary: Several models for chirality-induced spin selectivity (CISS) in charge transfer have been proposed, but rarely compared directly with experiments. This step is essential for their validation and future progress of the field. Here we investigate a broad class of radical pair states associated with different microscopic models by computing the related electron-paramagnetic resonance spectra. This allows us to evidence peculiar signatures of different radical pair states, to study their experimental accessibility and identify conditions to verify proposed microscopic models.

AI.tldr: 手性诱导自旋选择性(CISS)的多种理论模型缺乏与实验的直接比较。本文通过计算不同微观模型下自由基对态的电子顺磁共振(EPR)谱，揭示了各自由基对态的特征信号，评估其可观测性，并提出验证这些微观模型的条件。
AI.motivation: CISS在电荷转移中已有多种模型，但很少直接与实验对比，而这种对比是验证模型、推动领域进展的关键。
AI.method: 针对不同微观模型对应的广泛自由基对态，计算其相关的电子顺磁共振(EPR)谱。
AI.result: 获得了不同自由基对态的特征信号(peculiar signatures)，并评估了它们在实验上的可观测性(experimental accessibility)。
AI.conclusion: 可为区分和验证不同CISS微观模型提供实验可检验的判据，指导后续实验设计。

title: Isotope Effects at Classical Cost through Mass-Differentiable Machine Learning
summary: Isotope effects govern fractionation and modulate reactivity, with applications from hydrogen energy to environmental science and catalysis, yet predicting them requires resolving small isotope-dependent free-energy differences that remain very challenging for conventional path-integral simulations in complex systems. Here we introduce iso-EPIGS, a path-integral coarse-graining framework built on a mass-differentiable neural network that reconstructs the mass- and temperature-dependent path integral centroid free-energy surface. Classical molecular dynamics on the learned surface yields rigorous isotope-resolved thermodynamics without explicit path-integral sampling. Benchmarks spanning gas, liquid, and crystalline phases, including liquid water and oxalic acid crystal, reproduce reference path-integral isotope free-energy differences, enthalpies, and lattice parameters at near classical computational cost. Crucially, iso-EPIGS trained solely on all-H and all-D isotopologues retains high accuracy for unseen partially deuterated isotopologues, demonstrating robust transferability across nuclear masses. Iso-EPIGS makes accurate isotope-effect simulations feasible for complex systems and lays the groundwork for foundation models of isotope effects across chemical space.

AI.tldr: iso-EPIGS：基于质量可微神经网络的路径积分粗粒化框架，可在近似经典计算成本下实现复杂体系的同位素效应模拟。
AI.motivation: 同位素效应在氢能、环境和催化等领域意义重大，但传统路径积分模拟难以解析微小的同位素依赖自由能差，在复杂体系中计算成本高昂。
AI.method: 提出iso-EPIGS框架，采用质量可微神经网络重建质量与温度依赖的路径积分质心自由能面；在学到的自由能面上运行经典分子动力学，无需显式路径积分采样即可获得同位素解析的热力学量。
AI.result: 在气体、液体和晶相（含液态水、草酸晶体）基准测试中，重现了参考的同位素自由能差、焓和晶格参数，成本接近经典模拟；仅在全H和全D同位素体上训练，对未见的部分氘代同位素体仍保持高精度，展现跨核质量的迁移性。
AI.conclusion: iso-EPIGS使复杂体系的精确同位素效应模拟成为可能，并为化学空间的同位素效应基础模型奠定基础。

title: Competing symmetry breaking and topology in quantum spin chains
summary: We investigate how spontaneous symmetry breaking and symmetry-protected topology compete and cooperate in one-dimensional quantum spin-1/2 systems. We introduce two families of local Hamiltonians with $\mathbb{Z}^{\,}_{2}\times\mathbb{Z}^{\,}_{2}\times\mathbb{Z}^{T}_{2}$ symmetry which host a zoo of broken-symmetry phases with and without gapless boundary spins, namely, six long-range-ordered gapped phases that differ by their $\mathbb{Z}^{\,}_{2}$-symmetry-breaking patterns (FM$^{\,}_{x,y,z}$ and Neel$^{\,}_{x,y,z}$), their partner symmetry-protected topological phases (FM$^{\mathrm{SPT}}_{x,y}$ and Neel$^{\mathrm{SPT}}_{x,y}$), and two gapless phases (gFM$^{\,}_{z}$ and gNeel$^{\,}_{z}$) with incommensurate $\mathbb{Z}^{T}_{2}$-breaking magnetic long-range order and central charge $\mathsf{c}=1$. Direct transitions between competing gapped phases can be continuous or weakly first order. We demonstrate that continuous phase transition lines have exotic critical properties. For example, a line of deconfined quantum critical points (between the Neel$^{\,}_{x}$ and Neel$^{\,}_{y}$ phases) described by Tomonaga-Luttinger liquid theory is terminated by the gFM$^{\,}_{z}$ phase at a Lifshitz tricritical point which exhibits spontaneous breaking of the continuous U(1) symmetry despite the locality and one-dimensionality of the Hamiltonian, contrary to a naive expectation from the Hohenberg-Mermin-Wagner-Coleman theorem. Furthermore, critical lines between symmetry-protected topological phases with different $\mathbb{Z}^{\,}_{2}$-symmetry breaking (e.g., Neel$^{\mathrm{SPT}}_{x}$ and Neel$^{\mathrm{SPT}}_{y}$) additionally retain low-energy boundary degrees of freedom, realizing symmetry-enriched criticality (or a gapless SPT phase). Our results reveal unconventional mechanisms by which competing symmetry breaking and topology generate ordered critical phases and multicriticality.

AI.tldr: 研究一维自旋-1/2体系中自发对称破缺与对称保护拓扑的竞争与合作，构建了两族具有Z2×Z2×Z2^T对称性的局域哈密顿量，揭示了包括三重临界点、去禁闭量子临界线及对称富集临界性在内的非常规临界现象。
AI.motivation: 理解自发对称破缺与对称保护拓扑如何在低维量子系统中竞争与共存，尤其是它们如何共同产生有序临界相和多临界性。
AI.method: 引入两族具有Z2×Z2×Z2^T对称性的一维自旋-1/2局域哈密顿量，构造并分类包含六种长程有序能隙相、其SPT伴侣相以及两种无能隙相（中心荷c=1）的相图，并分析各相之间的直接相变性质。
AI.result: 发现竞争能隙相之间的相变可为连续或弱一级；连续相变线具有奇异临界性质，例如由Tomonaga-Luttinger液体描述的去禁闭量子临界线终止于Lifshitz三重临界点，该点自发破缺连续U(1)对称性；不同Z2破缺模式的SPT相之间的临界线保留低能边界自由度，实现对称富集临界性（无能隙SPT相）。
AI.conclusion: 竞争的自发对称破缺与拓扑可产生有序临界相及多临界性，揭示了超越Hohenberg-Mermin-Wagner-Coleman朴素预期的非常规机制。

title: Can end-to-end learning from raw electronic structure explain magnetic anisotropy?
comment: 16 pages, 6 figures, 3 tables, Supporting Information included
summary: Machine-learning models trained directly on electronic spectra can predict spin--orbit-driven properties, yet models with comparable predictive accuracy may learn different electronic dependencies. We examine this problem using magnetic anisotropy in atomic-scale magnets and a validation strategy designed to assess the physical relevance of learned spectral relationships. We compare a bidirectional gated recurrent unit and a one-dimensional convolutional neural network, both trained to predict magnetic anisotropy energy (MAE) from spin- and orbital-resolved scalar-relativistic densities of states (SR-DOS). Despite comparable in-domain (ID) accuracy, the architectures learn only partly overlapping spectral dependencies. Shapley additive explanations identify spectral features shared between the two architectures that can be associated with plausible spin--orbit-coupling pathways consistent with second-order perturbation theory (PT2). Adding PT2-derived MAE contributions to the model inputs has little effect on ID performance but can improve transfer beyond the training domain, with gains differing between architectures. Controlled spectral perturbations further demonstrate that similar attribution patterns do not imply the same functional dependence of the predicted MAE on spectral weight. The contrasting responses provide a functional context for architecture-dependent out-of-domain transfer. End-to-end learning can identify candidate electronic signatures of magnetic anisotropy. Their credible microscopic interpretation, however, rests on convergent evidence from predictive performance, model comparison, physical theory, controlled spectral interventions, and evaluation under distribution shift.

AI.tldr: 本文研究机器学习模型从电子光谱预测磁各向异性能时，即使预测精度相当，不同架构学到的电子依赖关系也不同；需通过多证据融合评估其物理可信度。
AI.motivation: 直接基于电子光谱训练的机器学习模型虽能预测自旋-轨道驱动性质，但精度相当的模型可能学到不同的电子依赖关系，其物理相关性存疑。
AI.method: 以原子尺度磁体的磁各向异性为对象，比较双向门控循环单元与一维卷积神经网络，从自旋与轨道分辨的标量相对论态密度预测MAE；采用SHAP解释、引入PT2导出的MAE贡献，并进行受控光谱扰动与分布外迁移评估。
AI.result: 两架构域内精度相当，但学到的光谱依赖仅部分重叠；SHAP识别出与PT2一致的共享特征；加入PT2贡献对域内性能影响小，但可改善跨域迁移且增益因架构而异；扰动实验表明相似归因模式不代表相同的函数依赖。
AI.conclusion: 端到端学习能发现磁各向异性的候选电子特征，但其可靠的微观解释需依赖预测性能、模型比较、物理理论、受控干预与分布偏移评估的收敛证据。

title: High-resolution mapping of the phase boundary of the honeycomb-lattice Blume--Capel ferromagnet
summary: We present a high-resolution numerical study of the spin-1 Blume--Capel ferromagnet on the honeycomb lattice ($z=3$). Wang--Landau estimates of the joint density of states $Ω(E_1,E_2)$, combined with field mixing, are used to map the first-order transition line and locate the tricritical point at $(Δ_t,T_t)=[1.4819(2),\,0.4022(7)]$. Histogram reweighting of Metropolis simulations for $L=36$ and $48$ provides an independent consistency check, with a crossing temperature near $0.4039$, compatible with the Wang--Landau extrapolation. From the field-mixing analysis we obtain $r=-1.586(19)$, while the slope of the multicanonical coexistence line yields the consistent and more precise estimate $r=-1.587(5)$. Normalizing by the zero-temperature field $Δ_0=zJ/2$, the available honeycomb, square, triangular, and simple-cubic estimates cluster near $r/Δ_0\simeq-1.06$, corresponding to a magnitude about $6\%$ larger than the mean-field value $-1$; no systematic dependence on coordination number or dimensionality is resolved over the range examined. Finite-size scaling of $σ_Q$ gives $y_t=1.795(7)$, consistent with the tricritical Ising value $9/5$, while the fourth-order cumulant scaling is compatible with $y_g=4/5$. Deep in the first-order regime, the cumulant approaches the expected two-phase limit $U_Q\to2/3$. Multicanonical simulations up to $L=64$, using weights constructed directly from the Wang--Landau density of states for $L\le24$ and rescaled and refined for larger systems, yield an interface-tension exponent $μ=1.265(26)$, consistent with the tricritical prediction $(d-1)/y_g=5/4$. Finally, we map the continuous branch of the phase boundary from the same density-of-states data, obtaining $T_c(Δ=0)=1.157$; estimates sufficiently close to the tricritical point are affected by crossover from Ising to tricritical scaling.

AI.tldr: 用Wang-Landau与多重正则方法研究蜂窝晶格自旋-1 Blume-Capel铁磁体，精确定位三临界点并验证三临界Ising标度。
AI.motivation: 蜂窝晶格(z=3)的三临界行为及场混合参数r的普适性尚缺乏高精度检验，需辨析其与平均场及不同维度/配位数的关系。
AI.method: Wang-Landau估计联合态密度Ω(E1,E2)结合场混合确定一级相变线与三临界点；Metropolis直方图重加权(L=36,48)作一致性检验；多重正则模拟至L=64，权重由较小系统态密度外推细化。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持蜂窝晶格Blume-Capel模型的三临界Ising普适性，但场混合参数偏离平均场值约6%且不随配位数或维度系统变化。

title: Giant Magnetization Enhancement at Ultrathin Limit of an Orthoferrite
summary: Low-dimensional magnetic systems have received significant interest due to their high scalability and energy efficiency for future electromagnetic applications. However, low-dimensional magnetism at finite temperature is subject to Mermin-Wagner fluctuations, which make its realization highly challenging. Here, we propose structural modulation in the thin-film structure of an orthoferrite system to achieve a high low-dimensional magnetic response at room temperature. ErFeO3 epitaxial thin film with atomically precise thickness control demonstrates that the magnetic response at 300 K can be significantly enhanced compared to its bulk counterpart. The magnetic response reaches its maximum value of 3.7 MuB/f.u. for the 2 nm-thick epitaxial film. The characteristic domain structure resulting from epitaxial strain and orbital reconstruction at the surface, both arising from the thin film geometry, has been proposed as the microscopic origin of the giant magnetization enhancement. We show that magnetic ordering can indeed be realized in the 2D limit, with deliberate structural control of orthoferrite systems.

AI.tldr: 该文提出通过正交铁氧体薄膜的结构调制，在室温下实现高维低磁响应，2 nm厚ErFeO3外延薄膜磁响应达3.7 μB/f.u.。
AI.motivation: 低维磁体因可扩展性和能效受关注，但有限温度下受Mermin-Wagner涨落影响，其实现极具挑战。作者希望在室温下实现低维磁序。
AI.method: 对ErFeO3正交铁氧体采用外延薄膜结构调制，实现原子级精确的厚度控制。
AI.result: 300 K下ErFeO3薄膜的磁响应相比块体显著增强，2 nm厚外延薄膜磁响应最大达3.7 μB/f.u.。
AI.conclusion: 外延应变与表面轨道重构产生的特征畴结构是巨磁化增强的微观来源；通过刻意的结构控制，正交铁氧体体系可在二维极限实现磁有序。

title: From band reconstruction to Bogoliubov dispersion: How dz2-band enhances iron-based superconductivity
summary: Conventional understanding of iron-based superconductivity is usually established based on electronic bands at the Fermi level, leaving deeper bands overlooked as potential factor. Here, we expand this view by demonstrating that a deep-lying dz2 band below the Fermi level can be employed to enhance the superconducting paring strength. By using scanning tunneling microscope to mechanically change the crystal lattice of an iron-based superconductor, we observe an upward shift of the deep-lying dz2 band related feature, leading to hybridization with the primary superconducting bands at the Fermi level. We visualize the novel evidence of this band hybridization and resulting enhanced superconducting gap through quasiparticle interference imaging, providing conclusive evidence that engineering such correlations between deep and pairing-active bands is a potent mechanism for amplifying the superconducting gap. This work refines the conventional view of pairing-relevant electronic structures and establishes band hybridization as an effective way to optimize superconducting materials.

AI.tldr: 通过机械调控晶格，使深能级dz2带上升并与费米面附近的主超导带杂化，从而增强铁基超导配对强度。
AI.motivation: 传统对铁基超导的理解主要基于费米面附近的电子带，深能级带长期被忽视，作者希望探究深能级带是否可作为增强超导配对的潜在因素。
AI.method: 利用扫描隧道显微镜（STM）机械改变铁基超导体的晶格，观察深能级dz2带特征的位移及其与费米面主超导带的杂化，并通过准粒子干涉成像进行可视化验证。
AI.result: 观测到深能级dz2带向上移动并与费米面主超导带杂化，准粒子干涉成像给出了带杂化及增强超导能隙的新证据。
AI.conclusion: 工程化深能级带与配对活跃带之间的关联是放大超导能隙的有效机制，带杂化可作为优化超导材料的有效途径，并修正了传统关于配对相关电子结构的认识。

title: Reading Altermagnetic Domains with Photon Drag
summary: Finite photon momentum allows second-order photocurrents in centrosymmetric space groups, where the conventional bulk photovoltaic effect is forbidden. Here we study the photon-drag response of altermagnets and show that its angular dependence reveals both the symmetry of the magnetic order and the Néel domain of the sample. For example, when a crystal rotation exchanges the two domains, the domain-even and domain-odd parts of the current appear in different angular harmonics, $4n$ and $4n+2$ for tetragonal $d$-wave altermagnets, so that two measurements rotated by $90^\circ$ on a single domain isolate the domain-odd current. We also find that these microscopic contributions exhibit opposite domain parities depending on light polarization. Under linear light, only the shift term is domain odd, while under circular light, the domain-odd channel switches to the injection, Fermi-surface, and contact principal-value terms. Mirror symmetries fix the angular phase of each harmonic and distinguish $d_{x^2-y^2}$, $d_{xy}$, and $g$-wave order. In contrast, conventional collinear antiferromagnets show no domain-odd photon-drag current, and in tetragonal ferromagnets the two parts share the same harmonics. Although the altermagnetic spin splitting does not require spin-orbit coupling (SOC), SOC is essential to observe the domain-odd charge current. Our work uncovers distinct signatures of altermagnetism in photon drag and provides a route to all optical magnetic readouts of altermagnets.

AI.tldr: 该文研究交变磁体(altermagnet)的光子拖拽响应，发现其角度依赖可同时揭示磁序对称性与Néel畴，并提供全光学磁读取路径。
AI.motivation: 中心对称空间群中常规体光伏效应被禁止，但有限光子动量允许二阶光电流。作者希望利用这一点探索交变磁体的磁序与畴结构特征。
AI.method: 理论分析交变磁体的光子拖拽响应，考察角度依赖、谐波成分(如四方d波交变磁体的4n与4n+2谐波)、光偏振(线偏振与圆偏振)及镜面对称性对相位和各微观贡献项(shift、injection、Fermi-surface、contact principal-value)的影响。
AI.result: 畴偶与畴奇电流出现在不同角度谐波中，单畴上旋转90°两次测量可分离畴奇电流；线偏振下仅shift项为畴奇，圆偏振下畴奇通道切换至injection、Fermi-surface与contact项；镜面对称固定各谐波相位并区分d_{x^2-y^2}、d_{xy}与g波序；常规共线反铁磁无畴奇光子拖拽电流，四方铁磁两部分谐波相同；SOC对观测畴奇电荷电流至关重要。
AI.conclusion: 该工作揭示交变磁性在光子拖拽中的独特特征，为交变磁体的全光学磁读取提供了可行途径。

title: Non-Perturbative Vibrational Excitation by Arbitrary Electric Fields from Classical Phase-Space Dynamics
summary: We present a non-perturbative framework for the quantum treatment of vibrational excitation in molecular systems driven by electric fields with arbitrary time dependence. For harmonic potentials with linear dipole coupling, the field-induced dynamics is exactly described by a displaced coherent state, whose evolution is completely determined by a complex phase-space coordinate. Closed-form expressions for this coordinate reveal a clear distinction between resonant and non-resonant regimes. The resulting vibrational populations follow a Poisson distribution determined by a dimensionless time-dependent phase-space displacement, for both resonant and non-resonant driving. Resonant driving results in an enhanced phase-space displacement, whereas finite detuning between the driving and vibrational frequencies leads to an exponential suppression of the phase-space displacement and vibrational excitation. While the approach reduces to the standard time-dependent perturbation theory in the weak-field limit, it remains valid in the strong-field regime, where perturbative treatments fail. Our results provide a transparent phase-space picture of vibrational control and enable non-perturbative state preparation in ultrafast spectroscopy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个非微扰框架，用位移相干态精确描述任意时变电场驱动的分子振动激发，给出闭式相空间坐标，揭示共振增强与非共振指数抑制规律。
AI.motivation: 强场下传统微扰理论失效，需要一种能统一处理共振与非共振、弱场与强场的非微扰方法，来理解电场驱动的分子振动激发与相干控制。
AI.method: 针对线性偶极耦合的谐振子势，将场诱导动力学精确表示为位移相干态，由复相空间坐标完全决定其演化；推导该坐标的闭式表达式，区分共振与非共振情形。
AI.result: 振动布居服从由无量纲时变相空间位移决定的泊松分布，共振与非共振驱动均如此；共振驱动增强相空间位移，有限失谐导致位移与振动激发的指数抑制；弱场极限退化为标准含时微扰理论，强场下仍有效。
AI.conclusion: 该工作给出振动控制的清晰相空间图像，支持超快光谱学中的非微扰态制备。

title: Symmetric Mode Ansatz: Theory of Magnon Collective Modes in Chern Insulators
summary: Moiré materials host integer and fractional Chern insulators (FCIs) where time-reversal is broken spontaneously by flat band ferromagnetism. In twisted MoTe2, unlike in quantum Hall, opposite spins carry opposite Chern numbers and realize Ising ferromagnetism with gapped magnon excitations. Clarifying the nature of these collective modes and the origin of the magnon gap is key to understanding the stability of the Chern magnets in these materials. To do so, we develop a generalized single-mode approximation, which we call the symmetric mode ansatz (SyMA), to describe the low-energy magnon spectrum. We find it to be in exceptional agreement with numerical calculations at integer filling, and qualitatively accurate across fractional fillings including FCIs. To explain the accuracy of the SyMA, we present two families of Hubbard models (including the Haldane model and continuum ideal bands) whose collective modes are analytically solvable and for which the SyMA is either exact or an accurate approximation. For a class of these models where SyMA is exact, we prove two-sided bounds on the zero-momentum magnon gap in terms of the Chern number, Berry curvature, and quantum metric, revealing that uniform quantum geometry is sufficient for stabilizing magnetism in Chern bands.

AI.tldr: 提出对称模式拟设(SyMA)描述莫尔材料低能磁振子谱，与数值结果高度吻合，并给出Chern磁体磁振子能隙的量子几何下界。
AI.motivation: 扭曲MoTe2等莫尔材料中由平带铁磁自发破坏时间反演形成整数/分数Chern绝缘体，其Ising铁磁磁振子的集体模式性质及能隙起源尚不清楚，这关系到Chern磁体的稳定性。
AI.method: 发展广义单模近似——对称模式拟设(SyMA)，用于描述低能磁振子谱；并构造两类可解析求解的Hubbard模型(Haldane模型与连续理想带)验证其精确性或近似精度。
AI.result: SyMA在整数填充与数值计算高度吻合，在分数填充及FCI中定性正确；在可精确求解的模型类中，证明了零动量磁振子能隙的双侧界，用Chern数、Berry曲率和量子度规表示。
AI.conclusion: 均匀量子几何足以稳定Chern带中的磁性。

title: Markov length can diverge in systems whose universal physics is spatially Markovian
summary: Conditional mutual information (CMI) probes spatial non-Markovianity and plays a central role in a recently developed framework for defining mixed-state phases based on local reversibility. This framework sharply distinguishes exponentially decaying from algebraically decaying CMI, since the latter obstructs equivalence to a state with finite Markov length. Here we show that states that flow to the same renormalization-group (RG) fixed point can nevertheless exhibit qualitatively different CMI. Starting from a critical Gibbs state of a finite-range local classical Hamiltonian, whose CMI vanishes beyond the interaction range, we show that an RG-irrelevant perturbation that breaks detailed balance generically generates algebraically decaying CMI. Crucially, these power-law tails are cutoff-suppressed: although they lead to an infinite Markov length at every fixed lattice cutoff, they vanish as a positive power of the cutoff in the continuum limit. We construct solvable models that exhibit this phenomenon and predict that the Ising-symmetric critical point of Toom's cellular automata generically exhibits such behavior. We also find analogous cutoff-suppressed CMI in the high-temperature paramagnetic phase of the long-range Ising paramagnet, in contrast with the genuine power-law CMI at the finite-temperature critical point in this same model that survives the continuum limit. We also derive a general result that in one spatial dimension, CMI decays faster than the inverse square of the buffer length if and only if the long-distance physics is Markovian.

AI.tldr: 本文表明流向同一RG不动点的状态可具有定性不同的CMI：RG无关且破坏细致平衡的扰动会普遍产生代数衰减的CMI，但其幂律尾在连续极限下被截断压制而消失。
AI.motivation: 近期基于局域可逆性的混合态相框架用CMI衰减（指数vs代数）来区分相，但此前未明确流向同一RG不动点的态是否必然具有相同的CMI行为，本文探究这一等价性假设。
AI.method: 以有限程局域经典哈密顿量的临界Gibbs态（CMI在相互作用程外为零）为起点，引入破坏细致平衡的RG无关扰动；构造可解模型，并预测Toom元胞自动机的Ising对称临界点行为；同时分析长程Ising顺磁体的高温相；另推导一维CMI衰减与马尔可夫性的判据。
AI.result: RG无关扰动普遍生成代数衰减CMI，导致每个固定格点截断下马尔可夫长度无穷；但这些幂律尾随截断以正幂次消失，在连续极限下消退。在长程Ising高温顺磁相也发现类似截断压制CMI，而该模型有限温临界点的真幂律CMI在连续极限下仍存在。
AI.conclusion: CMI可区分流向同一RG不动点但物理上不同的态，说明基于局域可逆性的混合态相判据需谨慎处理截断效应；一维中CMI衰减快于缓冲长度平方倒数当且仅当长程物理是马尔可夫的。

title: Localization of Candidate Kikuchi Regions in RHEED Images: Visibility and Annotation Boundaries
comment: 42 pages, 16 figures, 16 tables; supplementary information included after the references
summary: Kikuchi lines and bands in reflection high-energy electron diffraction (RHEED) carry information on crystal geometry and electron scattering, but are often obscured by intense diffraction streaks. We combine multiscale convolution with spatial detail from skip connections and independent supervision that allows overlapping regions to localize streaks and candidate Kikuchi regions separately. Using manual polygon annotations made before model-assisted editing, the Kikuchi intersection-over-union (IoU) on 29 laboratory test images from separate growth batches was $0.6290 \pm 0.0137$. We then performed supervised adaptation to public chalcogenide images and stratified images by Kikuchi visibility using the median ratings of three observers who rated the images separately, two of whom rated with predictions hidden. With all 244 training images, IoU for the clear-feature group of 10 test images was $0.5014 \pm 0.0336$, whereas ambiguous images gave lower values. With 100 training images, clear-group IoU was $0.5171 \pm 0.0073$; expanding the training set also reduced responses on images without target features. Reported uncertainties are sample standard deviations across four laboratory runs or three adaptation runs. Public-image adaptation used reference masks of mixed provenance, including prediction-derived drafts. The method converts visual cues into inspectable spatial regions, providing a basis for analysis of line positions, intersections, and local intensity.

AI.tldr: 提出结合多尺度卷积、跳跃连接与独立监督的分割方法，从RHEED图像中分离衍射条纹与Kikuchi区，实验室图像IoU为0.6290±0.0137，公开图像清晰组IoU约0.50。
AI.motivation: RHEED中的Kikuchi线与带蕴含晶体几何和电子散射信息，但常被强衍射条纹遮蔽，难以直接分析。
AI.method: 采用多尺度卷积+跳跃连接保留空间细节，并对重叠区域用独立监督分别定位条纹与候选Kikuchi区；实验室图像用人工多边形标注，公开硫系化合物图像做监督域适应，并按Kikuchi可见度（三位观察者中位评分）分层。
AI.result: 29张实验室测试图Kikuchi IoU为0.6290±0.0137；公开图像244张训练时清晰组（10张）IoU为0.5014±0.0336，模糊组更低；100张训练时为0.5171±0.0073，且扩大训练集降低了无目标特征图像的响应。不确定性为多次运行的样本标准差。
AI.conclusion: 该方法将视觉线索转化为可检查的空间区域，为线位置、交点和局部强度分析提供基础；但公开图像参考掩码来源混杂（含预测生成草稿）。

title: Electric and Heat Transport in One-Dimensional SNS Junctions with Energy-Dependent Transmission
summary: We investigate the phase-independent dc components of the electric and heat currents through a one-dimensional superconductor-normal-metal-superconductor (SNS) junction subject to chemical-potential and temperature differences between two superconducting reservoirs. Using a scattering approach based on the Bogoliubov-de Gennes equations, we incorporate multiple Andreev reflections while retaining the energy dependence of transmission through the normal region. We compare energy-independent, quantum-dot-type, and quantum-point-contact transmission profiles. At low bias, both currents exhibit nonlinear features associated with the superconducting gap and multiple Andreev reflections. Their responses to a temperature difference depend remarkably on the transmission profile. At a small finite bias, the electric current depends weakly on the temperature difference for the energy-independent and quantum-dot-type profiles, whereas the quantum-point-contact profile produces a pronounced nonlinear response. The heat current depends nonlinearly on the temperature difference for all three profiles over the parameter range investigated. These results highlight the role of the transmission profile in nonlinear electric and heat transport through SNS junctions and provide a microscopic reference for related transport studies in mesoscopic fermionic superfluid junctions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究一维SNS结在化学势与温差驱动下的相位无关直流电、热流分量，发现透射谱形状显著影响非线性输运响应。
AI.motivation: 探究SNS结中相位无关的电、热流分量如何受化学势差与温差驱动，并厘清透射谱形状对输运的影响。
AI.method: 基于Bogoliubov-de Gennes方程的散射方法，包含多重Andreev反射并保留正常区透射的能量依赖，比较能量无关、量子点型和量子点接触三种透射谱。
AI.result: 低偏置下两种电流均呈与超导能隙及多重Andreev反射相关的非线性特征；对温差的响应强依赖透射谱：小偏置下能量无关与量子点型电流对温差依赖弱，量子点接触型则呈显著非线性响应；三种谱下热流均随温差非线性变化。
AI.conclusion: 透射谱形状在SNS结非线性电、热输运中起关键作用，为介观费米超流结的相关输运研究提供微观参考。

title: Cooperative STT and SOT switching in perpendicular magnetic tunnel junctions: Role of the pulse-end magnetization state
summary: Spin--orbit torque MRAM (SOT-MRAM) is a leading candidate for next-generation nonvolatile memory, offering high speed, endurance, and architectural compatibility. However, in conventional SOT switching, the magnetization remains near the in-plane region at pulse termination, making the final state highly sensitive to post-pulse relaxation dynamics and prone to back-switching. To overcome this, we propose a field-free scheme in which the transverse SOT drives large-angle precessional excitation while the perpendicular spin-transfer torque (STT) biases the trajectory toward the reversed $-z$ state. Micromagnetic simulations reveal a nonlinear switching boundary in the $J_{\mathrm{STT}}$--$J_{\mathrm{SOT}}$ parameter space, originating from the distinct dynamical roles of the two torques: SOT primarily governs the excitation and crossing of the dynamical separatrix, whereas STT controls the terminal trajectory and final-state selection. An analytical macrospin model, based on the stability analysis of the current-induced equilibrium, reproduces the critical-boundary trends as functions of current density, Gilbert damping $α$, and uniaxial anisotropy $K_\mathrm{u}$, and distinguishes dynamic anti-damping and static instability branches. Systematic analyses of pulse duration, damping, anisotropy, and the STT--SOT balance further demonstrate that reliable ultrafast switching requires not only sufficient excitation to cross the separatrix before pulse termination, but also precise control of the pulse-end magnetization state to minimize post-pulse relaxation. These results establish that the pulse-end state, rather than the instantaneous torque amplitude, is the decisive factor governing switching speed and reliability in coupled STT--SOT systems.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一种无外场STT辅助的SOT-MRAM翻转方案，利用垂直STT偏置SOT驱动的进动轨迹，解决脉冲结束时磁矩易回跳问题，并揭示脉冲末端态是决定翻转速度与可靠性的关键因素。
AI.motivation: 传统SOT翻转在脉冲结束时磁矩仍处于面内附近，最终态对脉冲后弛豫高度敏感，易发生back-switching，且通常需要外磁场，故需无场且稳定的翻转机制。
AI.method: 提出SOT横向驱动大角度进动、垂直STT将轨迹偏置向反向-z态的无场方案；通过微磁模拟揭示J_STT-J_SOT参数空间的非线性翻转边界；建立基于电流诱导平衡态稳定性分析的宏观自旋解析模型。
AI.result: 解析模型复现了临界边界随电流密度、Gilbert阻尼α和单轴各向异性K_u的变化趋势，并区分动态反阻尼与静态失稳两个分支；系统分析脉宽、阻尼、各向异性及STT-SOT配比的影响。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的超快翻转不仅需要脉冲结束前越过动力学分界线，还需精确控制脉冲末端磁矩态以减少脉冲后弛豫；脉冲末端态而非瞬时力矩幅值是决定耦合STT-SOT系统翻转速度与可靠性的关键。

title: Predictable Accuracy of Martini 3 Absolute Protein-Ligand Binding Free Energies across 15 Targets
summary: Alchemical free-energy calculations predict protein-ligand binding affinities with close-to-experimental accuracy, but their cost restricts them to small sets of ligands. Coarse-grained (CG) models such as Martini 3 retain a rigorous statistical-mechanical treatment at a fraction of this cost, yet their accuracy for protein-ligand binding has not been assessed systematically. Here, we compute absolute binding free energies for 172 ligands across 15 protein targets with a Martini 3 double-decoupling protocol and compare them against atomistic FEP+ and OpenFE references. Martini underbinds for every target, by 2.7 to 8.7 kcal/mol. This offset is systematic: it comprises a uniform contribution that grows with the number of charged pocket residues. A linear model in this number, which requires only the protein structure, reduces the mean absolute error from 5.7 to 1.2 kcal/mol in leave-one-out cross-validation, close to the 1.0 kcal/mol obtained with exact per-target offsets. The ranking of ligands within a target varies more widely (median Spearman $ρ$ of 0.32, from $-$0.41 to 0.89) and is rationalized by the structure-activity relationship of each series: Martini ranks ligands well when their affinity is driven by hydrophobicity, $π$-stacking, or size, and poorly when it is driven by hydrogen bonding or charge. Both trends follow from Martini's calibration against bulk partitioning, which captures neither the dielectric environment of a binding pocket nor the directionality of hydrogen bonds. While MMGBSA retains the atomistic detail needed to rank congeneric ligands, Martini yields physically meaningful free energies, and its coarse-graining maps many atomistically distinct molecules onto one representation, making it a complementary tool for rapidly spanning chemical space.

AI.tldr: 本文用Martini 3粗粒化模型对15个靶点172个配体计算绝对结合自由能，发现系统性低估（2.7–8.7 kcal/mol），但该偏差可由带电口袋残基数线性校正，MAE从5.7降至1.2 kcal/mol。
AI.motivation: 全原子自由能计算（如FEP+）精度高但成本大，仅适用于小规模配体；Martini 3等粗粒化模型成本低但缺乏对蛋白-配体结合精度的系统评估。
AI.method: 对15个蛋白靶点、172个配体，采用Martini 3双解耦（double-decoupling）方案计算绝对结合自由能，并与全原子FEP+和OpenFE结果对比；分析系统偏差与带电口袋残基数的关系，构建线性校正模型并进行留一交叉验证。
AI.result: Martini对所有靶点均低估结合（2.7–8.7 kcal/mol），偏差随带电口袋残基数增加；线性校正模型（仅需蛋白结构）将MAE从5.7降至1.2 kcal/mol，接近精确靶点偏移的1.0 kcal/mol。靶内配体排序变异性大（Spearman ρ中位数0.32，范围−0.41至0.89）：疏水、π堆积或尺寸主导时排序好，氢键或电荷主导时排序差。
AI.conclusion: 偏差根源在于Martini基于体相分配系数的校准，无法捕捉口袋介电环境与氢键方向性。Martini提供有物理意义的自由能且能快速跨越化学空间，与保留原子细节的MMGBSA互补。

title: Cooper Instability of a Magnetic Wigner Crystal
summary: Recent scanning tunneling microscopy has directly imaged electronic crystals in rhombohedral hexalayer graphene, and magnetotransport measurements suggest that superconductivity and charge-density-wave order emerge from a common spin-valley-polarized ferromagnetic metal at nearby carrier densities. Motivated by these observations, we ask whether collective modes in a magnetic Wigner crystal can mediate pairing in this setting. We address this question by studying the Cooper problem for two electrons in the first conduction band of the Wigner crystal. Unlike conventional phonon-mediated pairing, the collective mode (boson) energies and single-particle (fermion) dispersion are comparable scales controlled by the electron density, leaving no small parameter for an adiabatic expansion. Moreover, because the magnetic Wigner crystal is not time-reversal invariant, the usual Cooper logarithmic divergence in the pairing susceptibility is absent, so the attraction must exceed a finite threshold for pairing to occur. These unusual features motivate a numerical experiment to see whether the crystal's own vibrations can bind electrons. We obtain the crystalline ground state and its collective mode spectrum within Hartree--Fock and time-dependent Hartree--Fock approximation, and derive the electron--phonon Hamiltonian using the quasiboson approximation. Solving the resulting two-electron problem, we find that phonon-mediated attraction exceeds the pairing threshold, with chiral $p$-wave pairing as the leading instability. Within these approximations, we show that collective modes of a Wigner crystal can indeed favor chiral pairing despite broken time-reversal symmetry. Our results provide an encouraging starting point for developing a full many-body theory to study electronic crystallization and superconductivity.

AI.tldr: 本文研究磁性Wigner晶体中的集体模式能否介导配对，通过求解双电子Cooper问题发现声子介导吸引超过配对阈值，手性p波配对为主导不稳定性。
AI.motivation: 近期STM在菱方六层石墨烯中直接观测到电子晶体，磁输运测量暗示超导与电荷密度波序从共同的自旋-谷极化铁磁金属中涌现。作者由此提出问题：磁性Wigner晶体中的集体模式能否在此情形下介导配对。
AI.method: 在Wigner晶体第一导带中研究两电子Cooper问题。在Hartree-Fock和时间依赖Hartree-Fock近似下获得晶体基态及集体模式谱，用准玻色子近似推导电子-声子哈密顿量，求解所得双电子问题。
AI.result: 声子介导的吸引超过配对阈值，手性p波配对为主导不稳定性。由于磁性Wigner晶体破坏时间反演对称性，通常的Cooper对数发散消失，吸引需超过有限阈值才能配对。
AI.conclusion: 在这些近似下，Wigner晶体的集体模式确实能促进手性配对，尽管时间反演对称性破缺。结果为发展完整的多体理论研究电子晶化与超导提供了有希望的起点。

title: Quantum annealing of the random transverse-field Ising model in one, two, and three dimensions
summary: Quantum annealing must be sufficiently slow to prevent defect formation. We study this problem in the random transverse-field Ising model via the adiabatic theorem to obtain the limiting rate at which defect formation can be avoided. Our approach based on the strong-disorder renormalization group (SDRG) technique views the annealing process as a gradual aggregation of strongly coupled clusters, giving access to the elementary events of error formation. We present a scaling theory of the statistics of these events in general dimensions and confront it to an extensive numerical analysis carried out in one, two, and three dimensions by an efficient implementation of the SDRG method. This approach is also validated by exact diagonalization in one dimension by means of the free-fermion technique. Our results consistently show a logarithmically slow decrease of the error density with the annealing time, characterized by the dimension-dependent critical exponents of the corresponding infinite-disorder fixed point of the model. Furthermore, we provide a map of individual events of potential defect formation in the excitation energy - control parameter plane, which may help in the design of optimal annealing paths.

AI.tldr: 研究随机横场Ising模型中量子退火速率与缺陷形成，基于SDRG得出误差密度随退火时间对数缓慢下降，并由维度相关的无序不动点临界指数刻画。
AI.motivation: 量子退火需足够慢以避免缺陷形成，但避免缺陷的极限速率及其普适规律尚不清晰，尤其在随机无序与高维情形下缺乏系统理论。
AI.method: 以绝热定理结合强无序重整化群(SDRG)，将退火视为强耦合团簇的逐步聚合，构建任意维度下误差形成事件统计的标度理论；在一、二、三维进行高效SDRG数值分析，并用一维自由费米子精确对角化验证。
AI.result: 误差密度随退火时间呈对数缓慢下降，其标度由无限无序不动点的维度相关临界指数决定；给出一、二、三维一致的数值与精确对角化验证结果，并绘制激发能量-控制参数平面上的潜在缺陷形成事件图。
AI.conclusion: SDRG框架能统一刻画随机量子退火中的缺陷形成与标度行为，事件图谱有助于设计最优退火路径。
