title: Assessing the Reliability of Foundational Machine Learning Potentials for Evaluating the Veracity of the Crystallography Open Database
summary: The Crystallography Open Database (COD) contains over half a million experimentally determined crystal structures. Validation of crystallographic data proceeds at three hierarchical levels, the third of which assesses the physical plausibility of structures. This level has typically relied on empirical heuristics or expert judgment, which are slow and error-prone given the size of crystallographic databases and the rate at which new structures are deposited. Here we assess whether universal machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) can automate this level of validation. Of the 522 086 COD entries, 317 457 (60.8\%) passed a data-quality filter removing disordered structures, formula mismatches and unmodelled solvent. These structures were relaxed with M3GNet, and 314 153 (99.0\%) converged without a large change in cell volume. For most entries the relaxed and deposited volumes are nearly identical. Convergence and volume change thus provide simple criteria for identifying relaxations that do not confirm the deposited structure. A manual inspection of 327 structures showed that no single descriptor threshold (energy, largest force, or atomic displacement) separates valid from invalid structures. A comparison of M3GNet, CHGNet, PET-MAD and PET-OAM on 524 selected structures revealed model-specific failures: M3GNet distorts cyclopentadienyl and other $π$ ligands, and both M3GNet and CHGNet distort thiophene and thiazole rings, whereas the PET models preserve these motifs. All models detected missing hydrogen atoms, and at least some detected spurious hydrogens, incorrectly assigned atom types, and two previously unreported coordinate errors. No single model detected all error types. MLIP relaxation is therefore a useful but model-dependent screening tool, and combining several models is preferable to relying on any single one.

AI.tldr: 评估通用机器学习原子间势(MLIP)能否自动化晶体数据库第三层次(物理合理性)验证。对COD中317457条结构用M3GNet弛豫,99.0%收敛;但无单一描述符能区分正误结构,且各模型存在特定失效,需多模型组合。
AI.motivation: 晶体数据库物理合理性验证长期依赖经验启发式或专家判断,面对超50万条COD条目和新结构快速入库,这种方法缓慢且易错,需要自动化手段。
AI.method: 从522086条COD条目中经数据质量过滤(去除无序结构、化学式不匹配、未建模溶剂)保留317457条,用M3GNet弛豫并以收敛性和体积变化作为判据;对327条人工检查三种描述符(能量、最大力、原子位移);并在524条结构上比较M3GNet、CHGNet、PET-MAD、PET-OAM四个模型。
AI.result: 99.0%(314153条)在体积无大幅变化下收敛,多数条目弛豫体积与沉积体积几乎一致。无单一描述符阈值可分离有效/无效结构。模型特定失效:M3GNet扭曲环戊二烯基及π配体,M3GNet与CHGNet扭曲噻吩和噻唑环,PET模型保留这些基元。所有模型检测出缺失氢,部分检测出虚假氢、错误原子类型及两处未报道的坐标错误,但没有单一模型检出所有错误类型。
AI.conclusion: MLIP弛豫是有用但依赖模型的筛选工具,组合多个模型优于依赖单一模型。

title: Pressure-induced double-dome superconductivity in doped kagome metal Cs(V0.86Ta0.14)3Sb5 without charge density wave
summary: The vanadium-based kagome superconductor CsV$_3$Sb$_5$ exhibits an intricate interplay between charge density wave (CDW) and superconductivity (SC). Substituting Ta for V will suppress the CDW order and enhance superconductivity. Here, we report a high-pressure study up to 48 GPa on Ta-doped Cs(V$_{0.86}$Ta$_{0.14}$)$_3$Sb$_5$ with enhanced $T_\mathrm{c}$ around 5.29 K and without CDW order. At low pressures, unlike the characteristic $``$M-shaped" temperature-pressure phase diagram of the pristine CsV$_3$Sb$_5$, the Ta-doped compound exhibits a distinct non-monotonic evolution. Initially, $T_\mathrm{c}$ drops slightly from 5.29 K at ambient pressure to 4.90 K at 0.33 GPa, before increasing to a maximum of 5.70 K at 0.61 GPa. Upon further compression, $T_\mathrm{c}$ decreases continuously to 0.98 K at 12.3 GPa. At higher pressures, $T_\mathrm{c}$ rises again, reaching 4.46 K at 47.7 GPa. This evolution of $T_\mathrm{c}$ establishes two superconducting domes under pressure, which are similar to those in CsV$_3$Sb$_5$. Our results demonstrate that pressure-induced double-dome superconductivity is intrinsic to these V-based kagome superconductors, even in the absence of long-range CDW order.

AI.tldr: 通过高压研究Ta掺杂Cs(V0.86Ta0.14)3Sb5，发现即使无CDW序，该体系仍展现两个超导穹顶，表明双穹顶超导是V基kagome超导体的内禀特征。
AI.motivation: 探究CsV3Sb5中CDW与超导的相互关系：Ta替代V可抑制CDW并增强超导，借助高压研究无CDW序时超导行为是否改变，以厘清双穹顶超导是否依赖CDW序。
AI.method: 对Tc约5.29 K且无CDW序的Ta掺杂Cs(V0.86Ta0.14)3Sb5进行高达48 GPa的高压输运/超导测量，追踪Tc随压力的演化。
AI.result: 低压下Tc非单调变化：从常压5.29 K降至0.33 GPa的4.90 K，升至0.61 GPa的5.70 K，再降至12.3 GPa的0.98 K；高压下回升至47.7 GPa的4.46 K，形成两个超导穹顶。
AI.conclusion: 压力诱导的双穹顶超导是V基kagome超导体的内禀性质，不依赖长程CDW序的存在。

title: Enhancement of the Topological Hall Effect through Engineering the Skyrmion Size and Shape
summary: The topological Hall effect of skyrmions is a promising electrical probe of magnetic textures, but its small magnitude limits applications. In this work, we theoretically investigate the topological Hall effect induced by sparsely distributed skyrmions in the weak-coupling limit, focusing on how the size and shape of the skyrmion affect the Hall effect. To this end, we used a formalism based on angular-momentum eigenstates, which enables systematic analysis within reasonable computation time. We found that, in clean materials where the electron mean-free path is comparable to or larger than the skyrmion size, the Hall effect depends considerably on the size and shape of the skyrmion. In particular, the Hall effect is largest when $k_Fλ\sim 1$, and its magnitude can be tuned by the domain-wall width of skyrmions. These findings provide a basis for investigating how the shape and size of skyrmions affect transport properties and demonstrate that the topological Hall effect is controllable by engineering these properties.

AI.tldr: 本文理论研究弱耦合极限下稀疏分布skyrmion诱导的拓扑霍尔效应，发现其大小和形状强烈影响霍尔效应，在k_Fλ~1时最大，并可通过畴壁宽度调控。
AI.motivation: 拓扑霍尔效应是探测磁性织构的有力电学手段，但其幅度过小限制了应用，需探索如何增强和调控该效应。
AI.method: 采用基于角动量本征态的形式化方法，在弱耦合极限下系统分析稀疏分布skyrmion的尺寸与形状对拓扑霍尔效应的影响。
AI.result: 在电子平均自由程与skyrmion尺寸相当或更大的洁净材料中，霍尔效应显著依赖skyrmion的尺寸和形状；当k_Fλ~1时效应最大，且幅度可由skyrmion畴壁宽度调节。
AI.conclusion: 研究为理解skyrmion形状和尺寸对输运性质的影响提供了基础，并表明拓扑霍尔效应可通过工程调控skyrmion几何特性来实现可控。

title: Optical absorption spectra from the $GW$-Bethe-Salpeter framework for thousands of atoms
summary: The frequency-dependent absorption and emission of light determine the colors of matter and underpin today's technologies, from solar cells to light-emitting diodes. Predicting optical properties from first principles remains a computational challenge, especially for large and disordered systems. The $GW$ plus Bethe-Salpeter equation ($GW$-BSE) approach provides predictive accuracy for optical properties, but conventional implementations become costly as system size grows. Here, we present a $GW$-BSE framework combining real-time propagation, atom-centered basis sets, and a locally optimized real-space resolution of the identity. The cost of each propagation step scales quadratically with system size and roughly equals the cost of one self-consistent-field iteration in a density-functional calculation with a semilocal functional. This computational efficiency allows us to calculate the absorption spectrum of a nanographene containing 4616 atoms and opens a path toward routine calculations of optical properties for large disordered systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种结合实时传播、原子中心基组和局部优化的实空间单位分解的GW-BSE框架，将每步传播成本降至与半局域DFT一次自洽场迭代相当，实现了4616原子纳米石墨烯的吸收光谱计算。
AI.motivation: 从第一性原理预测光学性质仍是计算挑战，尤其对大型无序系统；传统GW-BSE方法随系统尺寸增长成本过高。
AI.method: 结合实时传播(real-time propagation)、原子中心基组(atom-centered basis sets)以及局部优化的实空间单位分解(locally optimized real-space resolution of the identity)构建GW-BSE框架。
AI.result: 每步传播成本随系统尺寸二次增长，约等于半局域泛函DFT一次自洽场迭代的成本；成功计算了含4616个原子的纳米石墨烯吸收光谱。
AI.conclusion: 该高效方法为大型无序系统的光学性质常规计算开辟了路径。

title: Gauging Modulated Symmetries: Bond Algebras, Higher-Form Symmetries, and Symmetry-Enriched Topological Order
summary: We develop a constructive framework for characterizing modulated symmetries and their gauging in $d$-dimensional lattice systems. The modulation profiles are organized as a finite-dimensional representation of the space group acting on a finite Abelian internal symmetry group. Since the corresponding automorphism group is finite, the nontrivial spatial action factors through a finite quotient of the space group, leading to periodic modulation patterns and providing a classification framework for discrete Abelian modulated symmetries. The symmetry-allowed local interactions are systematically obtained from a kernel construction, which also yields an algebra of open operators. Upon gauging, its elements are transmuted into extended Wilson and boundary operators while retaining their algebraic relations. In the deconfined regime, the resulting algebra realizes a mixed 't Hooft anomaly, providing a microscopic route to Abelian crystalline symmetry-enriched topological phases (SETs). These SETs do not mix electric and magnetic sectors, which transform in mutually contragredient representations, thereby preserving their braiding pairing. We illustrate the framework through explicit examples and show that several models present in the literature fit naturally within our construction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个构造性框架，用于刻画d维格点系统中调制对称性及其规范化（gauging），并借此给出阿贝尔晶体对称富化拓扑相（SETs）的微观实现路径与分类方案。
AI.motivation: 调制对称性（空间依赖的对称变换）在格点模型中广泛出现，但缺乏统一的构造与分类框架。作者希望系统刻画离散阿贝尔调制对称性，并理解其规范化后如何产生晶体对称富化拓扑相。
AI.method: 将调制剖面组织为空间群在有限阿贝尔内禀对称群上的有限维表示。由于相应自同构群有限，非平凡空间作用通过空间群的有限商群分解，得到周期调制模式与分类框架。通过核（kernel）构造系统获得对称允许的局域相互作用与开算符代数，再进行规范化，使元素转化为扩展Wilson算符和边界算符。
AI.result: 规范化解禁禁闭区中所得代数实现混合't Hooft反常，给出阿贝尔晶体SET的微观路径。此类SET不混合电、磁扇区，二者处于相互对偶（contragredient）表示，从而保持编织配对。文中给出显式例子，并表明文献中若干模型自然纳入该框架。
AI.conclusion: 该框架统一刻画了离散阿贝尔调制对称性及其规范化，连接了调制对称性、混合反常与晶体对称富化拓扑相，并为已有模型提供统一解释。

title: Controlling transitions between nonequilibrium states through active bath engineering
summary: We develop a family of control protocols for finite-time transitions between active nonequilibrium steady states using the noise-color (correlation rate) as the sole control parameter. By reverse-engineering the second moment dynamics of an active Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process, we determine the time-dependent correlation rate required to realize a prescribed evolution of the system's state. We experimentally implement these protocols with a micrometer-sized optically trapped particle coupled to an engineered active bath, demonstrating transitions substantially faster than the natural relaxation while keeping the confining potential, noise amplitude, and temperature fixed. Our approach extends engineered swift-equilibration methods to far-from-equilibrium steady states by directly controlling the temporal correlations of an active environment. We show how physical constraints impose a speed limit on finite-time transitions, while the freedom in choosing the prescribed system evolution can be exploited to eliminate control discontinuities, minimize the admissible transition time, or optimize a thermodynamic cost.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出并以实验实现了利用噪声关联率（噪声色）作为唯一控制参数，在非平衡稳态之间实现有限时间快速转变的控制协议。
AI.motivation: 现有快速平衡（swift-equilibration）方法主要针对平衡态，尚缺乏对远非平衡稳态之间有限时间转变的控制手段，本文旨在将此类方法推广到活跃（active）非平衡环境。
AI.method: 通过反向设计活跃Ornstein-Uhlenbeck过程的二阶矩动力学，确定实现预设状态演化所需的时间依赖关联率；并在光镊捕获的微米颗粒与人工设计活跃浴耦合的系统中进行实验验证，保持约束势、噪声幅度与温度不变。
AI.result: 实验展示了显著快于自然弛豫的稳态转变；同时揭示物理约束对转变速度的限制（速度极限），并说明可通过选择不同的预设系统演化来消除控制不连续、最小化可行转变时间或优化热力学代价。
AI.conclusion: 通过直接调控活跃环境的时间关联，可将工程化快速平衡方法扩展至远非平衡稳态，为活跃系统的有限时间控制提供了新途径。

title: A hinged honeycomb with zero bulk modulus retaining more than four-fifths of its constituent's shear modulus
summary: A Poisson's ratio near -1 indicates only that the bulk modulus is small compared with the shear modulus. In solid-void structures, the mechanism that frees the dilation usually weakens the resistance to shear as well, resulting in both moduli becoming small. In two-dimensional linear elasticity, we demonstrate that this loss is not inevitable. We consider a honeycomb of regular hexagonal blocks of a single incompressible isotropic elastic solid, joined along their whole edges by ideal interfaces that allow relative sliding along a direction inclined to the edge normal. Collective infinitesimal block rotations produce an exact dilational mechanism, so the effective bulk modulus vanishes, while sixfold symmetry ensures isotropy. The interfaces, however, transmit traction along their whole length. In a solid-void realization, each interface is replaced with fine solid plates separated by void, which bend easily yet retain their capacity to transmit axial force. Such dilational materials, which expand or contract freely while resisting every change of shape, could serve as interlayers that accommodate thermal or swelling mismatch while still transmitting shear, and as components in stents and deployable structures that change size without changing shape. An explicit, statically admissible stress field and the complementary energy principle yield a rigorous lower bound on the retained shear modulus, and a limiting argument transfers this bound to the solid-void mixtures. The honeycomb retains more than four-fifths of its constituent's shear modulus at zero bulk modulus: the supremum S of the normalized shear modulus of such mixtures satisfies S > 0.8528 > 4/5, exceeding the value attained by Milton's construction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种二维蜂窝结构，由不可压缩固体六边形块体通过可滑动界面拼接，实现体积模量为零而保留超过80%剪切模量的极端弹性材料。
AI.motivation: 泊松比接近-1意味着体积模量远小于剪切模量。在固-空结构中，释放膨胀的机制通常也会削弱抗剪切能力，导致两个模量都变小。作者希望证明这种剪切模量的损失在二维线性弹性中并非不可避免。
AI.method: 构造由单相不可压缩各向同性弹性固体的规则六边形块组成的蜂窝结构，块体沿整个边缘通过理想界面连接，允许沿与边缘法向成一定角度的方向相对滑动。块体的集体无穷小旋转产生精确的膨胀机制使有效体积模量消失，六重对称保证各向同性。固-空实现中用细固体板替代界面，板间为空洞，易弯曲但能传递轴向力。通过显式静力容许应力场和互补能量原理导出保留剪切模量的严格下界。
AI.result: 蜂窝结构在体积模量为零时保留超过五分之四的组分剪切模量：该类混合物归一化剪切模量的上确界S满足S > 0.8528 > 4/5，超过Milton构造所达到的值。
AI.conclusion: 这类膨胀材料可自由膨胀或收缩同时抵抗任何形状变化，可用作承受热失配或膨胀失配同时传递剪切的夹层，以及尺寸变化而不改变形状的支架和可展开结构。

title: Displacement-Field-Induced Ionization of Defect States in High-Quality hBN
summary: Encapsulation of two-dimensional (2D) materials with hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) is widely used to fabricate ultraclean van der Waals (vdW) heterostructures for optoelectronic and quantum transport studies. These devices are often operated under strong out-of-plane displacement fields that tune the electronic properties of the active 2D material, while the surrounding hBN is typically assumed to remain electronically inert. This assumption, however, neglects defect states that are present even in high-quality hBN crystals. Here, we probe their response to the applied displacement field using monolayer graphene encapsulated between hBN crystals as a sensitive charge sensor. Increasing the displacement field induces notable charge transfer between graphene and hBN, producing additional electron doping of 10-20x10^9 cm^(-2) even at the moderate displacement field (~0.5 V nm^(-1)), while simultaneously increasing carrier-density inhomogeneity of the graphene layer. Both effects are consistent with ionization of defect states within the hBN bandgap, with the bulk density ~1-7x10^(-5) nm^(-3) varying across different hBN crystals. Our results show that displacement-field-induced defect ionization in hBN can modify the electronic response of vdW heterostructures, with direct implications for device design and interpretation of experiments.

AI.tldr: 本文以hBN封装的单层石墨烯作为电荷传感器，发现外加位移场会电离hBN带隙中的缺陷态，导致石墨烯额外电子掺杂及载流子密度不均匀性增加。
AI.motivation: 封装2D材料的器件常在强垂直位移场下工作，而hBN通常被视为电学惰性。但该假设忽略了高质量hBN晶体中仍存在的缺陷态，其对外加位移场的响应尚不明确。
AI.method: 将单层石墨烯封装于hBN晶体之间，作为敏感的电荷传感器，测量不同位移场下石墨烯的电荷转移与载流子密度分布。
AI.result: 增大位移场引发石墨烯与hBN间显著电荷转移，在~0.5 V/nm的中等场下即产生10-20×10^9 cm^-2的额外电子掺杂，同时增加石墨烯的载流子密度不均匀性；不同hBN晶体的体缺陷密度约1-7×10^-5 nm^-3。
AI.conclusion: hBN中位移场诱导的缺陷电离会改变vdW异质结构的电子响应，对器件设计和实验解读具有直接影响。

title: Unitary Coupled Cluster Nuclear Shielding Constants in a Quantum Linear Response Framework
summary: We present calculations of nuclear shielding constants, a key ingredient in nuclear magnetic resonance spectroscopy, within a quantum-computing-suitable framework. We employ quantum linear response (qLR) theory in combination with the unitary coupled cluster (UCC) ansatz and its orbital-optimized (oo-UCC), factorized (fUCC), and orbital-optimized factorized (oo-fUCC) variants. The methods are assessed for seven small molecules against CASCI, CASSCF, CCSD, and CCSD(T) reference calculations. The different UCC-based qLR approaches yield shielding constants in good agreement with comparable classical methods. Factorization, which is necessary for quantum-computing implementations, has only a negligible effect on the calculated shielding constants. Orbital optimization, in contrast, leads to substantial improvements, with oo-UCC and oo-fUCC showing markedly better agreement with CCSD and CCSD(T). Our results establish oo-fUCC combined with qLR as a promising approach for computing nuclear shielding constants on quantum computers.

AI.tldr: 本文在量子计算框架下结合量子线性响应(qLR)理论、UCC及其变体(oo-UCC、fUCC、oo-fUCC)计算核屏蔽常数，结果显示轨道优化显著提升精度，oo-fUCC结合qLR是量子计算机上计算核屏蔽常数的有前景方法。
AI.motivation: 核屏蔽常数是核磁共振谱的关键量，但需在量子计算可行的框架下高效、精确地计算，为此探索适合量子实现的UCC类方法与qLR的结合。
AI.method: 采用量子线性响应(qLR)理论，结合UCC ansatz及其变体(oo-UCC、fUCC、oo-fUCC)，对七个小分子计算核屏蔽常数，并与CASCI、CASSCF、CCSD、CCSD(T)参考结果对比。
AI.result: 各UCC-based qLR方法与对应经典方法结果吻合良好；因子化(fUCC)对屏蔽常数几乎无影响；轨道优化(oo)带来显著改进，oo-UCC和oo-fUCC与CCSD、CCSD(T)符合更好。
AI.conclusion: oo-fUCC结合qLR是量子计算机上计算核屏蔽常数的有前景方法。

title: Probing and Manipulating Quantum Materials with Strong-field Terahertz and Mid-infrared Radiation
summary: Emergent phenomena in quantum materials arise from interactions among different degrees of freedom. Identifying these interactions and establishing their roles in ordered states are central problems in condensed-matter physics and provide a basis for controlling material properties. Many relevant low-energy excitations and gaps lie in the terahertz (THz) and mid-infrared (MIR) range, where intense phase-stable fields can both interrogate nonlinear dynamics and drive selected degrees of freedom far from equilibrium. This review surveys recent progress in probing and manipulating quantum materials with strong-field THz and MIR radiation, with emphasis on nonlinear electronic dynamics, collective-mode coupling, symmetry-sensitive responses and field-induced changes in electronic structure and ordered states. Particular attention is given to developments enabled by the Synergetic Extreme Condition User Facility (SECUF).

AI.tldr: 综述强场太赫兹与中红外辐射探测和调控量子材料的研究进展。
AI.motivation: 量子材料的涌现现象源于不同自由度间的相互作用，识别这些相互作用并确定其在有序态中的角色是凝聚态物理核心问题。相关低能激发与能隙多位于THz和MIR波段，强相位稳定场可探测非线性动力学并驱动非平衡态。
AI.method: 综述性文章，梳理强场THz和MIR辐射探测与操纵量子材料的方法与进展。
AI.result: 总结了非线性电子动力学、集体模式耦合、对称性敏感响应以及场诱导电子结构与有序态变化等方面的进展，并特别关注SECUF推动的相关工作。
AI.conclusion: 强场THz/MIR是研究和调控量子材料多自由度相互作用的有力手段，SECUF等设施提供了重要平台。

title: The Fiedler dimension of networks of networks: from fractal to small-world architectures
summary: Is the relaxation of a modular network dictated by its modules or by the network that connects them? The answer fixes the time scales of diffusion, consensus, and synchronization, all set by the Fiedler eigenvalue. We show that, for bundled networks, the two levels act one after the other: a random walker must first escape from its module and then spread over the network that connects them. The equilibration time is the sum of these two times, the time needed to reach the base from inside a fiber and the relaxation time of the base, slowed down by the mass of the fibers. The consequences are unexpected. However large the modules are, a small-world core always imposes its own Fiedler dimension; the modules survive only as a logarithmic correction, which slows down equilibration and hides the true exponent up to sizes far beyond any real network. Effective dimensions measured on finite modular systems can therefore be systematically biased. We analytically work out all combinations of finite-dimensional and small-world bases and fibers, and compare them with numerically exact spectra of representatives of each category.

AI.tldr: 模块化网络的弛豫时间由"先逃出模块、再在连接网络上扩散"两步叠加决定，平衡时间等于纤维内部到达基座的时间加上基座弛豫时间（受纤维质量拖慢）。
AI.motivation: 论文旨在回答：模块化网络的弛豫是由模块还是由连接模块的网络决定？这一问题的答案决定了扩散、共识与同步的时间尺度（均由Fiedler特征值设定）。
AI.method: 针对"bundled networks"（纤维束+基座结构），将弛豫过程分解为两个连续阶段进行解析建模，推导出平衡时间为两项之和；并解析处理有限维与small-world的基座和纤维的所有组合，与各类代表网络的数值精确谱进行对比验证。
AI.result: 发现反直觉结论：无论模块多大，small-world核心总是强加其自身的Fiedler维度；模块仅以对数修正形式存留，拖慢平衡并掩盖真实指数，直到远超真实网络的尺度。有限模块系统上测得的有效维度会被系统性偏置。
AI.conclusion: 模块化网络的弛豫由连接模块的网络（基座）主导，模块只带来对数级修正；这导致在有限尺度上测得的有效维度存在系统性偏差。

title: Multifunctionality in Janus CrMCN4 (M = Si/Ge) Monolayers: Valleytronic Physics, Piezoelectric Response, and Photocatalytic Potential
summary: Two dimensional Janus semiconductors integrating spin-valley coupling, piezoelectricity, and tunable optical responses offer a platform for multifunctional nanodevices. Here, first-principles calculations reveal complementary composition and strain effects in CrSiCN4 and CrGeCN4 monolayers. Both are found to be nonmagnetic direct-gap semiconductors, with gaps of 1.23 and 1.09 eV using the Perdew-Burke-Ernzerhof functional including spin-orbit coupling, respectively. HSE06 hybrid-functional calculations retain the direct-gap character, yielding gaps of 1.46 eV for CrSiCN4 and 1.19 eV for CrGeCN4. Opposite out-of-plane spin character and Berry curvature emerge at K and K'. Biaxial strain reduces the respective gaps from 1.59 to 0.86 eV and 1.44 to 0.63 eV, drives direct-to-indirect transitions, and redshifts absorption while preserving valley spin contrast. CrGeCN4 exhibits larger in-plane piezoelectric response, whereas CrSiCN4 exhibits larger out-of-plane magnitude. Band-edge alignment satisfies the oxygen evolution reaction requirement but provides insufficient driving force for the hydrogen evolution reaction, motivating further strain-induced band-edge modulation toward overall water splitting. These results establish composition and strain as complementary controls for tailoring Cr-based Janus monolayers for valleytronic, optoelectronic, electromechanical, and photocatalytic applications.

AI.tldr: 本文通过第一性原理计算研究了CrSiCN4与CrGeCN4 Janus单层的自旋-谷耦合、压电性与光学响应，发现组分与应变可作为互补调控手段。
AI.motivation: 二维Janus半导体集成自旋-谷耦合、压电性与可调光学响应用于多功能纳米器件，需探索组分与应变对Cr基Janus单层的调控作用。
AI.method: 第一性原理计算，采用PBE（含自旋轨道耦合）及HSE06杂化泛函，分析能带、Berry曲率、双轴应变效应及压电响应。
AI.result: 两者均为非磁性直接带隙半导体，PBE+SOC下带隙为1.23和1.09 eV，HSE06下为1.46和1.19 eV；K与K'处出现相反的自旋与Berry曲率；双轴应变使带隙减小（1.59→0.86 eV、1.44→0.63 eV）并引发直接-间接转变和吸收红移；CrGeCN4面内压电响应更大，CrSiCN4面外更大；带边满足析氧反应但不足以驱动析氢反应。
AI.conclusion: 组分与应变可作为互补调控手段，用于设计谷电子学、光电子学、机电与光催化应用的Cr基Janus单层。

title: Magnonic cavity-enhanced quantum magnetometry with nitrogen-vacancy centre ensembles
summary: Nitrogen-vacancy (NV) centre ensembles are leading room-temperature magnetometers, but their sensitivity is usually extracted from a single resonance and relies on external microwave and bias-field hardware. This work proposes a chip-scale NV magnetometer built around a one-dimensional YIG/CoFeB magnonic crystal, in which a single structural defect forms a passive magnonic cavity and integrated permanent magnets supply the bias field. Micromagnetic simulations show a defect-localised spin-wave mode at 2.910 GHz inside the 2.5-3.0 GHz magnonic band gap, 40 MHz from the NV zero-field splitting, with a band structure that matches an independent plane-wave calculation. A Tavis-Cummings/Lindblad model in which the microwave reaches the NV ensemble through this mode predicts a hyperfine-resolved optically detected magnetic resonance spectrum that is strong only within the mode linewidth, and a dispersive homodyne response with one steep edge per $^{14}$N hyperfine line. The master-equation solutions agree with the closed-form homodyne steady state ($R^2 > 0.9999$) and with an approximate analytic ODMR theory (peak positions within 0.012 MHz). For a critically coupled readout with room-temperature electronics, combining the three edges gives a projected sensitivity of 93 pT/$\sqrt{\rm Hz}$, a $\sqrt{3}$-fold gain over the best single edge. Mapping the sensitivity against the NV-magnon coupling reveals an optimum near $g_{\rm ens}/2π\approx 0.2$-$0.4$ MHz, where it reaches 72 pT/$\sqrt{\rm Hz}$ for a 0.64 MHz spin linewidth and 19 pT/$\sqrt{\rm Hz}$ for 0.17 MHz, with thermal limits of 6.6 and 1.7 pT/$\sqrt{\rm Hz}$. The antenna-mode coupling, the NV-magnon coupling and the spin linewidth are therefore the main design levers.

AI.tldr: 提出基于一维YIG/CoFeB磁振子晶体的芯片级NV磁强计，利用结构缺陷形成无源磁振子腔并集成永磁体提供偏置场，理论上实现93 pT/√Hz灵敏度，并给出设计与优化指导。
AI.motivation: 传统NV色心磁强计灵敏度通常从单一共振提取，且依赖外部微波和偏置场硬件，难以实现芯片级集成。本文希望用磁振子晶体缺陷腔替代外部微波馈入，用集成永磁体替代外部偏置，从而实现被动式、片上化的NV磁强计。
AI.method: 构建一维YIG/CoFeB磁振子晶体，利用单个结构缺陷形成无源磁振子腔；用微磁模拟求解缺陷局域自旋波模式与能带结构，并与平面波计算交叉验证。采用Tavis-Cummings/Lindblad模型描述微波通过该模式耦合到NV系综的过程，求解主方程得到ODMR谱和色散型零差响应，并与闭式零差稳态解及近似解析ODMR理论对照。对临界耦合读出与室温电子学条件进行灵敏度投影，并扫描NV-磁振子耦合强度以寻找最优工作点。
AI.result: 在2.5–3.0 GHz磁振子带隙内发现2.910 GHz缺陷局域自旋波模式，距NV零场分裂40 MHz，能带结构与平面波计算一致。模型预测出仅在模式线宽内增强的超精细分辨ODMR谱，以及每条14N超精细线对应一个陡峭边缘的色散型零差响应；主方程解与闭式零差稳态解吻合（R²>0.9999），与近似解析ODMR理论峰位偏差小于0.012 MHz。临界耦合读出下，三边缘联合投影灵敏度为93 pT/√Hz，较最佳单边缘提升√3倍。灵敏度随NV-磁振子耦合存在最优值，约在g_ens/2π≈0.2–0.4 MHz，此时对0.64 MHz自旋线宽灵敏度达72 pT/√Hz，对0.17 MHz达19 pT/√Hz，热噪声极限分别为6.6和1.7 pT/√Hz。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明缺陷型磁振子晶体腔可作为NV系综的片上被动微波接口，配合集成永磁偏置实现芯片级磁强计。天线-模式耦合、NV-磁振子耦合和自旋线宽是决定灵敏度的主要设计杠杆，通过联合多边缘读出和优化耦合可获得显著灵敏度增益。

title: Gas-phase chemistry of $\mathrm{C}_3\mathrm{H}_3^+$: a key building block for carbon mass growth in space
summary:
The gas-phase chemistry of $\mathrm{C}_3\mathrm{H}_3^+$ plays a central role in the growth of carbonaceous species across a wide range of environments, from combustion systems to interstellar media. However, the presence of multiple isomers, primarily the linear propargyl cation and the cyclic cyclopropenyl cation, has so far prevented the determination of reliable isomer-specific reaction kinetics. In this work, we combine tunable vacuum-ultraviolet (VUV) photoionization with controlled ion--molecule reaction measurements to selectively produce and probe the reactivity of $\mathrm{C}_3\mathrm{H}_3^+$ isomers.
  By employing a titration approach, we extract isomer-specific reaction rate coefficients and branching ratios for reactions of $\mathrm{C}_3\mathrm{H}_3^+$ with $\mathrm{C}_2\mathrm{H}_4$, $\mathrm{C}_3\mathrm{H}_4$, and $\mathrm{C}_3\mathrm{H}_6$. Our results demonstrate a strong contrast in reactivity: the most stable cyclic isomer is found to be essentially unreactive under the investigated conditions, whereas the linear isomer exhibits efficient and diverse chemistry leading to the formation of larger hydrocarbon ions. In particular, the formation of $\mathrm{C}_6\mathrm{H}_5^+$ is observed, providing an important intermediate in pathways toward aromatic species.
  These findings help resolve long-standing ambiguities in previously reported rate coefficients and provide new quantitative constraints for kinetic and astrochemical models. More broadly, this work highlights the importance of isomer-specific chemistry in carbon growth processes and demonstrates the effectiveness of VUV-based photoionization methods for disentangling complex reaction networks in the gas phase.

AI.tldr: 该工作结合可调VUV光电离与受控离子-分子反应测量，通过滴定方法分离并测量了C3H3+两种异构体（线性炔丙基与环状环丙烯基）与C2H4、C3H4、C3H6反应的异构体特异性速率系数和分支比，发现环状异构体基本不反应而线性异构体反应高效多样，可生成C6H5+等芳香化中间体。
AI.motivation: C3H3+的气相化学在燃烧到星际介质的碳物种生长中至关重要，但多种异构体（主要是线性炔丙基阳离子和环状环丙烯基阳离子）共存，导致难以获得可靠的异构体特异性反应动力学数据，此前报道的速率系数存在长期歧义。
AI.method: 将可调真空紫外（VUV）光电离与受控离子-分子反应测量相结合，选择性产生并探测C3H3+异构体；采用滴定方法提取其与C2H4、C3H4、C3H6反应的异构体特异性速率系数和分支比。
AI.result: 观察到强烈的反应性对比：最稳定的环状异构体在所研究条件下基本不反应，而线性异构体表现出高效且多样的化学行为，生成更大的烃离子，特别是观察到C6H5+的生成，为通向芳香物种的重要中间体。新数据有助于澄清以往速率系数的歧义，并为动力学与天体化学模型提供定量约束。
AI.conclusion: 本研究强调异构体特异性化学在碳生长过程中的重要性，并证明基于VUV光电离的方法在解析气相复杂反应网络方面十分有效。

title: Multipolar fluctuations in localized $4f^2$-electron systems from dynamical mean-field theory: application to $\mathrm{PrCdNi}_4$
summary: Multipolar-fluctuation analysis based on density functional theory combined with dynamical mean-field theory is extended from $4f^1$- to $4f^2$-electron systems. Two methodological developments are presented. First, many-particle states are constructed within the $j$-$j$ coupling scheme in the $j=5/2$ subspace, so as to reproduce the crystalline-electric-field splitting of the $4f^2$ Hund's-rule ground-state multiplet. Second, multipolar susceptibilities and interactions between $4f^2$ multiplets are derived through a mapping from single-particle to many-particle bases. We apply this framework to PrCdNi$_4$, which has a non-Kramers $Γ_3$ doublet ground state, and propose a $(3z^2-r^2)$-type antiferroquadrupolar order at $\boldsymbol{q}=(2π,π,0)$ driven by the competition between nearest- and fourth-nearest-neighbor interactions. The formalism developed here is applicable to general $4f^n$-electron systems.

AI.tldr: 本文将基于DFT+DMFT的多极涨落分析从4f¹扩展到4f²电子体系，并在PrCdNi₄中预言了(3z²-r²)型反铁四极序。
AI.motivation: 原有基于密度泛函理论结合动力学平均场理论的多极涨落分析仅适用于4f¹体系，需扩展至更一般的4fⁿ体系以研究如PrCdNi₄等4f²材料的隐藏多极序。
AI.method: 在j=5/2子空间内采用j-j耦合方案构建多粒子态以重现4f² Hund基态多重态的晶体电场劈裂；通过单粒子到多粒子基的映射推导4f²多重态之间的多极磁化率与相互作用。
AI.result: 应用于具有非Kramers Γ₃双重态基态的PrCdNi₄，预言了由最近邻与第四近邻相互作用竞争驱动的q=(2π,π,0)处(3z²-r²)型反铁四极序。
AI.conclusion: 所发展的形式体系可推广至一般的4fⁿ电子体系。

title: Mutual Linearity of Complexes in Chemical Reaction Networks
summary: Exact statements about how a system far from equilibrium responds to changes in its rate constants are scarce beyond linear response, yet they are central to the control of biochemical networks. A notable exception is mutual linearity: in a jump process, controlling the rates of a single transition makes any two stationary probabilities obey an exact affine relation, arbitrarily far from equilibrium. With nonlinear mass-action kinetics, and conservation laws in place of a normalization, chemical reaction networks seem to defy mutual linearity since species concentrations obey no such relation. We show that it was there all along, in the complexes' activities (mass-action monomials) rather than in the concentrations of species. For zero-deficiency networks with a single linkage class, controlling one reaction makes any three stationary activities obey a linear relation whose coefficients are independent of the controlled rate constants, the conserved quantities (hence the initial state), and even of the stoichiometry of complexes. This predicts hidden activities and bounds the activity ratios the control can reach, while a violation signals nonzero deficiency or multiple linkage classes.

AI.tldr: 本文证明互线性（mutual linearity）在非线性质量作用动力学中以复合物活度形式普遍存在：对单联动类零亏量网络，控制单个反应速率可使任意三个稳态活度满足线性关系，系数与受控速率、守恒量及化学计量无关。
AI.motivation: 远离平衡态时，系统对速率常数变化的响应缺乏精确刻画，而这对于生化网络控制至关重要。已知的例外是跳过程（jump process）中的互线性，但在带守恒律的非线性质量作用动力学中，物种浓度似乎不再满足类似关系，因此需要寻找新的载体来恢复这一性质。
AI.method: 作者将研究视角从物种浓度转向复合物活度（即质量作用单项式），针对零亏量且单一联动类的化学反应网络进行分析，推导控制单一反应速率时稳态活度之间的线性约束关系。
AI.result: 发现控制一个反应即可使任意三个稳态活度满足线性关系；其系数与受控速率常数、守恒量（进而与初始状态）、甚至复合物的化学计量均无关。该关系可预测隐藏活度、约束控制可达的活度比，且关系被违反可指示亏量非零或存在多个联动类。
AI.conclusion: 互线性在化学计量网络中并未缺失，而是隐藏在复合物活度层面而非浓度层面；该精确关系为远离平衡的生化网络控制与结构诊断提供了新工具。

title: Data-Driven Variable-Exponent Analysis for Photoemission Yield Spectroscopy: An Autonomous Self-Diagnosing Framework Based on Integrated Residual Metrics
comment: 30 pages, 4 figures; supplementary material (28 pages) is provided as an ancillary file. Code and sample data: https://github.com/s-yagyu/n-pys
summary: Photoemission yield spectroscopy (PYS) is widely used for evaluating the electronic states of materials. As automated materials discovery advances, unsupervised extraction of physical information from ambient-air PYS data becomes important. Conventional fixed-exponent analyses and logarithmic transformations suffer from heteroscedasticity, which destabilizes estimation in low-signal regions. To address this, we propose a data-driven analysis framework based on the 1/n-Scan method, which operates directly in the original signal space, removing the geometric bias inherent in log-transform approaches. We further integrate a self-diagnostic quality-evaluation system that quantifies estimation uncertainty with Akaike weights, together with independent residual metrics--the normalized mean absolute error (NMAE), the RMSE-to-MAE ratio (RMR), the Durbin-Watson (DW) statistic, and a macroscopic metric ($ΔR^2$)--that distinguish hardware-related data degradation from a physical-model mismatch. Applying the framework to differently doped Si and a polycrystalline Au reference in air, we demonstrate autonomous detection, without assumptions on the emission mechanism, of the breakdown of the single-component approximation in heavily doped p-type Si, arising from the overlap of two emission components with different thresholds, as a statistical anomaly--a decrease in DW below its critical value with an auxiliary increase in $ΔR^2$, despite sound NMAE and RMR--independently confirmed by a two-component fit ($Δ$AIC $\approx$ 57, DW recovering from 0.8 to 2.0). For heavily doped n-type Si, the gradual surface evolution was classified as a change within the single-component description. This framework provides a robust, self-diagnosing analysis engine for closed-loop autonomous materials exploration.

AI.tldr: 提出基于1/n-Scan方法的数据驱动光电子产额谱(PYS)分析框架，直接在原信号空间操作，并集成Akaike权重自诊断质量评估及NMAE、RMR、DW、ΔR²等残差指标，可无假设地检测重掺杂p型Si单组分近似失效，为自主材料探索提供稳健分析引擎。
AI.motivation: 自动化材料发现需求增长，需从环境空气PYS数据无监督提取物理信息。传统固定指数分析与对数变换存在异方差性，在低信号区估计不稳定。
AI.method: 基于1/n-Scan方法在原信号空间直接分析，消除对数变换的几何偏差；集成Akaike权重量化估计不确定性，结合独立残差指标NMAE、RMR、Durbin-Watson统计量及宏观指标ΔR²，区分硬件退化与物理模型失配。
AI.result: 应用于不同掺杂Si及多晶Au参考：无需发射机制假设，自主检测到重掺杂p型Si中单组分近似失效（两个不同阈值的发射组分重叠），表现为DW低于临界值且ΔR²辅助增大，而NMAE和RMR正常；经双组分拟合确认（ΔAIC≈57，DW从0.8恢复至2.0）。重掺杂n型Si的表面演化被归类为单组分描述内的变化。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为闭环自主材料探索提供了稳健、自诊断的分析引擎。

title: Mode-selective electron-phonon coupling drives charge density waves in the kagome metals YRu$_3$Si$_2$ and LaRu$_3$Si$_2$
summary: YRu$_3$Si$_2$ and LaRu$_3$Si$_2$ host the highest charge density wave (CDW) transition temperatures ever reported in kagome metals, $T_{\mathrm{CDW}}\approx 800$ and 400~K, with propagation vectors $Q_{\mathrm{CDW}}\approx(1/2,0,0)$ and $(1/4,0,0)$, respectively. The microscopic mechanism behind these record values has remained unresolved. Here, we combine anharmonic phonon renormalization extracted from molecular dynamics driven by a machine-learned force field with mode-resolved electron-phonon coupling (EPC) analysis to identify this mechanism. The CDW is driven by mode-selective EPC: the Ru out-of-plane phonon modes couple the Ru-$d_{xz}/d_{yz}$ and Si-$p_x/p_y$ orbitals, and the phonon linewidth peaks sharply at $Q_{\mathrm{CDW}}$, while the featureless electronic susceptibility rules out Fermi-surface nesting. Phonon anharmonicity melts the CDW, and the anharmonic phonon spectra reproduce both $Q_{\mathrm{CDW}}$ and $T_{\mathrm{CDW}}$ in good agreement with experiments. Molecular dynamics simulations also visualize the CDW melting in real space. Chemical bonding analysis further shows that the smaller Y$^{3+}$ radius strengthens the Ru-Ru bonds, enhancing lattice rigidity and accounting for the factor-of-two higher $T_{\mathrm{CDW}}$ of YRu$_3$Si$_2$. Our results establish a unified microscopic picture of CDW formation and melting in kagome metals YRu$_3$Si$_2$ and LaRu$_3$Si$_2$.

AI.tldr: 该文结合机器学习分子动力学与非谐声子、模式分辨电声耦合分析，揭示了笼目金属YRu3Si2/LaRu3Si2高CDW转变温度的微观机制：模式选择性电声耦合驱动CDW、非谐性使其熔化，Y3+半径调控晶格刚性导致YRu3Si2转变温度翻倍。
AI.motivation: YRu3Si2与LaRu3Si2具有笼目金属中最高的CDW转变温度（约800K与400K），但其微观机制（为何如此之高、Q_CDW与T_CDW如何确定、两者差异来源）长期未解决。
AI.method: 将基于机器学习力场驱动的分子动力学所得的非谐声子重整化，与模式分辨的电声耦合分析相结合，辅以化学键分析，研究CDW形成与熔化的微观机制。
AI.result: CDW由模式选择性电声耦合驱动：Ru面外声子模式耦合Ru-d_xz/d_yz与Si-p_x/p_y轨道，声子线宽在Q_CDW处尖锐峰值，而无特征的电子磁化率排除了费米面嵌套。非谐声子谱复现的Q_CDW与T_CDW与实验吻合；分子动力学在实空间可视化了CDW熔化。较小的Y3+半径增强Ru-Ru键与晶格刚性，解释了YRu3Si2的T_CDW高一倍。
AI.conclusion: 建立了YRu3Si2与LaRu3Si2笼目金属中CDW形成与熔化的统一微观图像。

title: Tunable Ultrastrong Magnon-Magnon Coupling and Squeezed States in a Triaxial Van der Waals Antiferromagnet
comment: 15 pages, 4 figures, and Supplemental Material (25 pages)
summary: Achieving and quantifying ultrastrong magnon-magnon coupling (USC) remains a key challenge for quantum magnonics. Here, we demonstrate widely tunable USC between chiral (right- and left-handed) and acoustic or optical magnon modes in the van der Waals antiferromagnet $CrPS_4$. Using a full quantum model, we decompose the interaction into three microscopic interaction channels: the co-rotating term $g_1$ (mode hybridization), the counter-rotating term $g_2$ (two-mode squeezing), and, uniquely in the chiral regime, the self-squared term $g_3$ that mediates single-mode squeezing. The normalized coupling ratio reaches $g/f_g$ $\sim$ 0.41, entering the USC regime. Most significantly, we establish a complete protocol linking these USC parameters to a measurable quantum phenomenon: a squeezed magnon vacuum state. Our simulations not only visualize the chirality and polarization evolution of the hybrid modes but also demonstrate how to directly extract quadrature fluctuations and a substantial squeezing factor (up to $\sim$ 9.7 dB) from thermal noise-driven magnetization dynamics. This work provides a material-specific quantum framework for USC and a practical pathway to detect and exploit non-classical magnon states in low-damping two-dimensional magnets, opening a route toward quantum-enhanced spintronics and hybrid quantum information platforms.

AI.tldr: 在CrPS₄反铁磁体中实现手性与声学/光学磁振子模式间的超强耦合(USC)，耦合比达0.41，并建立从USC参数到可测量压缩磁振子真空态的完整方案。
AI.motivation: 实现和量化超强磁振子-磁振子耦合(USC)是量子磁子学的关键挑战，需要材料层面的量子框架及可检测的非经典磁振子态的实用路径。
AI.method: 在范德华反铁磁体CrPS₄中，基于全量子模型将相互作用分解为三个微观通道：共旋项g₁(模式杂化)、反旋项g₂(双模压缩)、以及手性区特有的自平方项g₃(单模压缩)。
AI.result: 归一化耦合比g/f_g ~ 0.41，进入USC区；模拟可视化杂化模式的手性与偏振演化，从热噪声驱动的磁化动力学中直接提取正交涨落及高达~9.7 dB的压缩因子。
AI.conclusion: 建立了USC的材料特异量子框架，并提供在低阻尼二维磁体中检测和利用非经典磁振子态的实用途径，为量子增强自旋电子学和混合量子信息平台开辟道路。

title: MAST: Motif-Augmented Diffusion with Search Tree for Spectroscopic Molecular Structure Elucidation
summary: Elucidating molecular structures from spectra is a foundational problem in chemical and materials characterization, yet remains challenging due to spectral ambiguity and the vast molecular space. Although recent diffusion-based generators show strong promise for spectra-conditioned elucidation, existing methods struggle to learn robust spectra-structure relationships from limited paired data when relying solely on global spectral representation. Moreover, the repeated full sampling inference strategy incurs substantial computation overhead. To address these limitations, we propose \textbf{MAST}, a \textbf{M}otif-\textbf{A}ugmented diffusion framework with \textbf{S}earch \textbf{T}ree, for joint 2D-3D spectroscopic molecular structure elucidation. MAST introduces explicit, interpretable \emph{motif priors} as intermediate evidences throughout denoising, reducing conditional ambiguity and facilitating spectra-conditioned optimization. We further cast diffusion sampling as \emph{reward-guided tree search} to prioritize high-reward denoising trajectories, yielding a compact set of spectra-consistent candidates under limited budgets. On the QM9S multi-spectra benchmark, MAST achieves \textbf{94.89\%} exact recovery and improves 3D fidelity, while preserving high chemical validity and stability. Code is available at https://github.com/Jia040223/MAST.

AI.tldr: 提出MAST，一种基于基元增强与搜索树的扩散框架，用于联合2D-3D光谱分子结构解析。
AI.motivation: 从光谱解析分子结构是化学与材料表征的基础问题，但受光谱歧义和巨大分子空间限制而困难。现有扩散生成方法仅依赖全局光谱表示，难以从有限配对数据学习稳健的光谱-结构关系，且重复全采样推理计算开销大。
AI.method: MAST引入显式、可解释的基元先验作为去噪过程中的中间证据，降低条件歧义并促进光谱条件优化；并将扩散采样建模为奖励引导的树搜索，优先选择高奖励去噪轨迹，在有限预算下生成紧凑的光谱一致候选集。
AI.result: 在QM9S多光谱基准上，MAST实现94.89%的精确恢复率，提升3D保真度，同时保持高化学有效性与稳定性。
AI.conclusion: MAST通过基元先验与搜索树策略有效缓解光谱歧义和计算开销问题，在光谱条件分子结构解析任务上取得先进性能。

title: Magnon band splitting without altermagnetism in CuF2
summary: Conclusive identification of an altermagnetic state requires going beyond mere symmetry arguments. We illustrate this in a combined computational and experimental study of the rutile-like material CuF$_2$, which is on the list of predicted altermagnets. Using ab initio and linear spin-wave calculations supplied by magnetization measurements, we show that CuF$_2$ in its experimental monoclinic structure can be described by a spin-$\frac12$ model of weakly coupled square-lattice layers with the in-plane coupling $J_1\simeq 115$ K and two synergistic antiferromagnetic interplane couplings amounting to 4% and 8% of $J_1$, respectively. Driven by long-range superexchange, these interlayer couplings are oblique to the square planes, resulting in the unit-cell doubling in the magnetically ordered state, thus effectively suppressing any altermagnetic band splitting. Concurrently, we identify unusually strong Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interactions, $|\mathbf D|/J_1\simeq 0.3$, that produce spin canting and, together with order-by-disorder effect, pin the Néel vector to the crystallographic $b$-axis. Additionally, DM anisotropy promotes magnon band splitting, but these bands remain non-chiral. Our results highlight the importance of relativistic effects even in $3d$ magnets with altermagnetic symmetries.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过计算与实验结合研究CuF₂，证明其磁有序态下交错磁（altermagnetic）能带劈裂被抑制，强调仅凭对称性判断交错磁性的不足。
AI.motivation: 仅凭对称性论证无法确证交错磁态，需结合具体材料的电子结构与相互作用来验证CuF₂是否真正具有交错磁劈裂。
AI.method: 采用从头算（ab initio）与线性自旋波计算，并结合磁化测量，构建CuF₂单斜结构的自旋-1/2模型；分析层间超交换、Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用及order-by-disorder效应。
AI.result: CuF₂可描述为弱耦合方格子层，面内耦合J₁≈115 K，两个层间反铁磁耦合分别为J₁的4%和8%；层间耦合斜交于方格平面导致磁有序态晶胞加倍，抑制交错磁能带劈裂。DM相互作用很强（|D|/J₁≈0.3），产生自旋倾斜，并联合order-by-disorder效应将Néel矢量固定于b轴；DM各向异性促进磁振子能带劈裂但能带非手性。
AI.conclusion: 即使3d磁体具有交错磁对称性，相对论效应（如DM相互作用）仍至关重要；CuF₂实验磁结构不表现交错磁能带劈裂。

title: Generation, Accumulation, and Utilization of Data in the Automatically Controlled End-Station of a Soft X-ray Beamline
summary: AI is rapidly transforming materials exploration, yet reliable AI-assisted research depends on experimental data that retains their context, provenance, and machine-readable structure. High-throughput synchrotron measurements therefore require more than automated data acquisition: data generation, accumulation, and utilization must be connected within a continuous workflow. Here, we present a data-centric research framework that integrates the PIONEER system, the OMNES, and ML analysis. The PIONEER system automates sample handling, vacuum transfer, and scanning XAS at the BL08U soft X-ray beamline of NanoTerasu, systematically generating large volumes of spatially resolved spectral data. Measurement and analysis files are stored in the cloud-based ARIM-mdx data system, while OMNES manages metadata describing samples, preparation procedures, measurement conditions, instrument settings, data locations, and analysis histories. Tabular and JavaScript Object Notation formats are used according to the metadata structure, with numerical values stored separately from units to facilitate machine processing. OMNES organizes these records based on causal relationships among experimental and analytical processes, linking samples, measurements, raw data, processed data, and analysis results through a relational data model and visualizing their relationships as a graph. This causality-based organization preserves experimental and analytical provenance and clarifies how each result was derived from the preceding processes and data. The accumulated spectra can subsequently be processed using ML methods, including dimensionality reduction and materials classification, and the resulting data can be registered back into OMNES. Previously reported ML analysis of BN XAS spectra is presented as an example of the analytical workflow that can be applied to data acquired at the beamline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个以数据为中心的研究框架，整合PIONEER自动化系统、OMNES元数据管理与ML分析，实现同步辐射高通量实验从数据生成到分析利用的连续工作流，并保留完整的实验与分析溯源。
AI.motivation: AI辅助材料探索依赖保留上下文、溯源和机器可读结构的实验数据；高通量同步辐射测量不仅需要自动采集，更需要数据生成、积累与利用的连贯工作流。
AI.method: 整合PIONEER系统（自动样品处理、真空转移、NanoTerasu BL08U软X射线束线扫描XAS）、OMNES（基于因果关系的关系数据模型管理样本、制备、测量、仪器、数据位置与分析历史）、云ARIM-mdx数据系统及ML分析；采用表格与JSON格式，数值与单位分离存储，并以图结构可视化关系。
AI.result: PIONEER系统可系统地产生大量空间分辨光谱数据；OMNES通过因果组织保留实验与分析溯源，清晰呈现结果推导路径；累积光谱可用降维与材料分类等ML方法处理，结果可回注册至OMNES，并以BN XAS光谱的ML分析作为示例。
AI.conclusion: 该框架实现了从自动化数据生成、结构化积累到ML分析的闭环工作流，保障了同步辐射高通量研究中数据的上下文与溯源，支持可复现、机器可处理的AI辅助材料研究。

title: Field-resolved hierarchy of superconducting energy gaps in PdTe
summary: Resolving how multiple superconducting energy scales evolve under magnetic field is important for distinguishing multiband, anisotropic, and surface-sensitive superconducting responses. Here, we investigate the superconducting state of PdTe using low-temperature soft point-contact spectroscopy in a sealed $^3$He immersion environment. The resulting Andreev-reflection spectra reveal two characteristic superconducting energy scales near 0.5 and 1.1 meV that are not adequately described by a single-gap BTK model. Both energy scales are progressively suppressed upon warming toward the same superconducting transition temperature $T_c$. In contrast, their magnetic-field evolution reveals two distinct characteristic fields near 4.5 and 7.5 kG. The lower scale is associated with the loss of the zero-resistance superconducting state, whereas the higher-energy spectroscopic response persists to substantially larger fields. Independent field-dependent gap analysis yields suppression scales consistent with those identified from the zero-bias conductance. These results reveal a field-resolved hierarchy of superconducting energy scales in PdTe and indicate superconducting responses with distinct magnetic-field robustness.

AI.tldr: 利用低温软点接触谱研究PdTe超导态，发现~0.5和~1.1 meV两个特征能量尺度，在磁场下呈现~4.5和~7.5 kG两个不同特征场，揭示了磁场分辨的多尺度超导层级。
AI.motivation: 厘清多个超导能量尺度在磁场下如何演化，对区分多带、各向异性及表面敏感的超导响应具有重要意义。
AI.method: 在密封³He浸没环境中进行低温软点接触谱测量，获得Andreev反射谱，并用BTK模型、零偏压电导及场依赖能隙分析进行拟合。
AI.result: Andreev反射谱显示~0.5和~1.1 meV两个能量尺度，单带BTK模型无法描述；两者随升温抑制至同一Tc，但磁场下特征场不同（~4.5与~7.5 kG）。低能尺度对应零电阻态消失，高能尺度在更大磁场下仍存在。
